 Process and Dev Tools är en del av Digital Solution & Operation Platform (DSOP) inom vår IT-organisation Digital & IT. Vi erbjuder stöd, förmågor, verktyg, tekniska plattformar samt processer för samtliga utvecklingsteam inom Länsförsäkringar. Vi arbetar enligt SAFe, med en tydlig vision att skapa en hållbar och effektiv produktutveckling – där DevSecOps är en självklar grundförutsättning
   

  

 Teamet består idag av Product Manager, Product Owners, DevSecOps Engineers, Scrum Masters och Process Owner som tillsammans ansvarar för våra förmågor och processer för IT-utveckling. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande laganda med högt i tak och stora möjligheter till utveckling.

title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform
description:
Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Define and drive the long-term architectural direction for Spotify's media pipeline across Content Platform.
* Lead large-scale technical initiatives that span multiple squads and organizations, including projects such as media delivery, codec rollouts, and future playback capabilities.
* Partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior engineers to align technical strategy with product priorities, reliability goals, and cost efficiency, acting as a key technical counterpart for media architecture.
* Guide architectural decisions across media ingestion, transcoding, packaging, storage, content delivery, and playback.
* Author and review RFCs, architecture decision records, and technical design documents that guide engineering teams and leadership.
* Mentor senior engineers across the organization, helping raise technical quality, architectural thinking, and engineering excellence.
* Bring a cost-aware engineering mindset by understanding how media architecture decisions impact compute, storage, CDN utilization, and long-term platform sustainability.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have deep expertise building large-scale media platforms spanning audio, video, encoding, transcoding, packaging, delivery, and playback technologies.
* You have successfully led architecture across multiple engineering teams and influenced technical direction beyond your immediate organization.
* You have significant experience designing and operating distributed systems at internet scale, including high-throughput media processing, large-scale storage, and globally distributed delivery infrastructure.
* You understand the architectural trade-offs between codecs, packaging formats, playback technologies, storage, networking, and infrastructure costs.
* You have a strong track record of leading multi-quarter technical initiatives from initial proposal through implementation and organization-wide adoption.
* You communicate technical ideas clearly through well-structured RFCs, design documents, and architectural decision records.
* You build trust through collaboration and technical credibility, bringing together teams with different priorities to deliver shared outcomes.
* You enjoy mentoring experienced engineers and helping organizations grow their technical capability.
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure providers, CDN vendors, and large-scale media delivery ecosystems is highly valued.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will define how AI is done at Rebtel. What tooling we standardise on, how we evaluate models we put in front of real users, what "good" looks like for our prompts and our pipelines. AI is going from a side project to the core of how Rebtel operates and what we ship to our users. We're hiring the second engineer on our ML/AI subteam to help build it classical ML for the business, LLM-powered systems for the product, and a clear production mindset on both.
 



  





 You'll sit inside the Data team, report to our Head of Data, and partner with one other ML/AI engineer to shape this capability from the ground up.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 




 You'll own work across two complementary tracks, and you'll ship in both.
 



 Classical ML, in production, for operational leverage
 


* Risk and fraud models across payments, top-ups, and account behaviour
* Churn prediction and retention modelling on a user base of a million-plus
* Forecasting, pricing, segmentation, and the next batch of operational problems we haven't tackled yet
* Owning models end-to-end scoping with stakeholders, building, deploying, monitoring, retraining



 LLMs and AI agents, from internal automation to in-product features
 


* Start with our customer support agents and automations: RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, tool-use, evaluation harnesses
* Move LLM capability into the product as user-facing features
* Help guide the company on where AI actually creates leverage, what to build, what to buy, what to ignore and turn the good ideas into shipped systems



**Requirements** 



* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office
* 5+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python, with real production ownership not just notebooks
* Strong fundamentals in classical ML: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and the unglamorous parts of keeping a model healthy in prod
* A genuine production mindset: monitoring, retraining, eval harnesses, CI/CD for models, and the instinct to debug when something drifts at 2am
* Comfort working the whole loop: stakeholder scoping → data → model → deployment → measurement → iteration
* Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to translate between business problems and ML ones
* Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents
* Built RAG systems, agentic workflows, or LLM-backed products that real users (or real internal teams) actually used
* Comfortable with vector databases, embeddings, prompt evaluation, and measuring LLM systems with something more rigorous than vibes
* Obsession with staying up-to-date on developments in the AI space
* Experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), containers, and a modern data stack
* Experience in MLOps tooling: MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes and feature stores is a plus
* Background in fintech, payments, telecom, or other regulated / operational domains is a plus



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
 



  





 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
 


* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.



*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About WPP Media**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Role Summary And Impact**
 At Choreograph, part of WPP Media, we’re leading the way in data-driven marketing solutions. We collaborate with the world’s most ambitious brands to solve complex challenges in media and marketing through data and technology. From econometrics and media buying algorithms to dashboards and strategic consulting, our work has an impact.
   

  

 WPP Media Sweden is building a local data engineering capability to support the entire Swedish organisation. The team will create the data foundations that help us work smarter across data, automation, measurement, Open Intelligence and AI, while turning Nordic and global technology investments into concrete value for the Swedish business.
   

  

 As an Data Engineer, you will learn to build and maintain reliable cloud-based data solutions that make client data easier to access, improve reporting automation and enable advanced analytics. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across data engineering, business intelligence, data science and media, with guidance and room to grow.
   

  

 If you’re curious, enjoy solving problems with data and want to start your career in a collaborative environment where your work supports teams across WPP Media Sweden, this could be the perfect role for you!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Support the development and maintenance of cloud-based data pipelines and infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Use Python and SQL to collect, transform and prepare data for reporting, measurement, analytics and AI use cases.
* Assist with data quality checks, monitoring and troubleshooting to help keep data products accurate and reliable.
* Work with colleagues in media, business intelligence and data science to understand internal needs and turn them into practical data solutions.
* Contribute to documentation, version control and repeatable engineering practices, including infrastructure and transformation workflows.
* Take part in training, workshops and knowledge sharing, while gradually taking ownership of well-defined engineering tasks.


**Skills And Experience**
 This is an entry-level position, suitable for candidates with approximately 0–2 years of experience. We welcome experience gained through education, internships, personal projects or limited professional experience, and the requirements below should be viewed in that context.
   

  

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a similar quantitative or technical field.
* Experience with programming, gained through education, projects or work experience. We use Python as our main coding language.
* Foundational knowledge of SQL and an understanding of how structured data is stored, transformed and queried.
* An interest in cloud platforms and modern data engineering. We use Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* A structured and curious approach to problem-solving, with care for data quality and documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain technical questions clearly to colleagues with different backgrounds.
* English: Fluent in speech and writing
* You have a valid work permit in Sweden


**Nice to have**
* Hands-on experience from internships, student projects or personal projects involving data pipelines, APIs, databases or cloud services.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Exposure to GCP, Terraform, Dataform, dbt or similar data engineering tools.
* Experience with Power BI or another business intelligence tool, or an interest in media, marketing or measurement.
* Swedish: good understanding in speech and writing


**Life At WPP Media & Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.
   

  

 In Sweden, our benefits include a SEK 3,000 wellness allowance, a 37,5-hour workweek, half-days and “klämdagar" off, 30 days of vacation, and two paid volunteer days per year. WPP Media Sweden is a member of Almega, and all employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (kollektivavtal), which ensures occupational pension, insurance, and other negotiated terms. We host regular team activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and wellness initiatives throughout the year.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

  

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

**Application**
 This is a full-time permanent position with a start date as soon as possible. We apply a six-month probationary period.
   

  

 In addition to reviewing your CV and conducting interviews, our recruitment process includes a testing phase. Selection and interviews are ongoing, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger and encourage applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Viktor Åhlen (viktor.ahlen@wppmedia.com) or Martin Söderhäll (martin.soderhall@wppmedia.com). Due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Staff Engineer | Group Operations
description:
**Every parcel we deliver starts with an engineering decision**
 At Instabee, we don't just move parcels — we solve some of the most complex physical-world problems in European logistics, at scale. From the algorithms that optimize a driver's route to the systems that predict terminal throughput hours in advance, our engineering decisions have a direct impact on millions of deliveries every day.
   

  

 We're now looking for a Staff Engineer to join our technical leadership group — someone who doesn't just write great code, but shapes how entire teams think, build, and deliver.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn't a traditional engineering role. As a Staff Engineer in Group Operations, you sit at the intersection of technical strategy and real-world logistics. You work alongside Product and Engineering Management to ensure multiple teams are building the right things, in the right way, at the right scale.
   

  

 Think of yourself as the technical glue — the person who bridges business ambition and engineering execution, who spots the hard problems before they become expensive ones, and who raises the bar for the entire engineering organization around you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive Technical Strategy & Architecture Set the technical direction across multiple teams in Operations. You'll guide engineers toward right-sized solutions — balancing high-scale stability with the speed needed to move the needle on operational KPIs.
* Tackle Genuinely Hard Problems Forecasting incoming parcel volumes, optimizing terminal throughput, routing thousands of drivers in real time — these are the kinds of challenges that define our business and your days.
* Champion Developer Experience Identify and eliminate technical friction. You'll lead initiatives to improve testing environments and deployment speed, keeping our engineering organization sharp and efficient.
* Bridge Business & Tech Translate complex business requirements into evolvable technical designs. You'll help teams understand how their code directly impacts the P&L of our logistics network — and why that matters.
* Mentor & Build Culture Act as a role model for the engineering community. You'll mentor senior engineers, promote a culture of learning from failure, and foster cross-team collaboration to ensure we don't reinvent the wheel.
* Enable Data-Driven Decisions Work closely with Data and Product teams to ensure our systems produce high-quality insights that power company-wide decisions.


**What We're Looking For**
 You don't need to be an expert in everything your teams do — but you should care deeply about helping them succeed. Since the teams you'll be leading work across both software engineering and data science, we're looking for someone who is comfortable in both worlds. We think you'll thrive in this role if you are:
   

  

* A Leader with Dual Competencies — You have a background in maths, forecasting, or ML, yet have spent years building robust, production-grade software systems. You're as comfortable discussing model accuracy as you are system reliability.
* A Technical Leader — You have broad experience building distributed systems and can navigate deep technical dives and high-level architectural trade-offs with equal confidence.
* Strategic & Pragmatic — You know that "perfect is the enemy of good." You favor an iterative mindset, delivering value early and often rather than waiting for the ideal solution.
* Operationally Curious — You're fascinated by the intersection of software and physical operations. Experience in logistics, routing, or hardware integration is a significant plus.
* A Communicator & Collaborator — You can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and thrive in a cross-functional environment where engineering, product, and business work closely together toward shared goals.
* A Quality Advocate — You hold a high bar for stability and security — but you know how to achieve it without killing the pace of innovation.


**Why join Instabee?**
 You won’t just be another employee here; you’ll be a builder. We offer the chance to sharpen your skills alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. If you’re someone who sees an inefficient process and thinks, "I can make that better," you’re going to love it here.
   

  

**The Perks**
 🌇
 **The Best View in Town** 
 Our Stockholm HQ offers a stunning 360-degree panorama.
   

  

 🐶
 **Dog-Friendly Culture** 
 No need to leave your best friend at home; our furry friends have their own floor!
   

  

 🏓
 **Unwind & Recharge** 
 Whether it's a competitive game of Foosball or a Karaoke solo, we take our fun seriously.
   

  

 👶
 **Family First** 
 We support our new parents with six months of parental pay.
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Gift** 
 Enjoy a fully paid day off to celebrate another trip around the sun.
   

  

 ⏰
 **Work-Life Harmony** 
 Hybrid working and flexible hours come as standard.
   

  

**The Journey So Far**
 Instabee was born when two pioneers, Budbee and Instabox, joined forces. Today, we are on a mission to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. We are a high-speed business, expanding across borders and constantly evolving. As our journey grows in scale and complexity, we need people like you to help us navigate the road ahead.
   

  

*As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Ctrl Digital is a marketing engineering and analytics consultancy. We help companies build the technical foundations they need to understand, use and activate their marketing and customer data.
 



  





 We’re now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our team.
   




 About the Role
 
  





 The role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics and marketing technology. You’ll work with modern data stacks to bring together data from marketing and digital platforms, model it in the cloud, and make it useful for reporting, analysis, activation and increasingly AI-assisted analytics.
 



  





 You won’t be working on the same data problem every day. Our projects span industries, technologies and use cases, from building marketing data warehouses and semantic layers to activation pipelines and AI-assisted analytics.
   




 What You’ll Work With
 
  





 Our projects typically involve building and developing marketing data infrastructure for clients. Depending on the engagement, you might:
 



  




* Build marketing data warehouses in BigQuery
* Integrate data from platforms such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta, CRM and other business systems
* Transform and model data using SQL and Dataform/dbt
* Design reliable data models, definitions, and semantic layers for reporting, analytics and AI
* Build data pipelines and integrations using APIs and ETL tools
* Make data available to Power BI, Looker Studio and other BI tools
* Develop solutions for AI-assisted and conversational analytics
* Build pipelines for activation, including offline conversions, audiences and customer value data
* Work closely with clients to translate business questions into technical solutions
* You’ll usually work across both longer client retainers and defined projects, often collaborating directly with marketing, analytics and data/IT teams.


 Who We’re Looking For
 
  





 We think you have around 2-4 years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, data engineering or a similar role. More importantly, you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems and learning new technologies.
 



  





 We’d like you to have:
 


* Strong SQL skills
* Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or similar
* Experience with dbt, Dataform or another data transformation framework
* A good understanding of data modelling and analytics vExperience working with Git
* Some experience with Python, APIs or data pipelines
* The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
* Professional working proficiency in English



  





 Experience with marketing data, GA4, Google Cloud, Power BI, Looker, server-side tracking or activation platforms is useful, but you don’t need to know our entire technology stack when you join. We’re also interested in people experimenting with LLMs, agents and new AI-based ways of working with data. Deep AI expertise isn’t required, but curiosity is.
   




 How You Succeed
 
  





 We’re a consultancy, so technical ability is only part of the job.
 



  





 You should enjoy working directly with clients, asking questions and understanding the problem behind the technical requirement. We value people who take ownership, are comfortable exploring unfamiliar technology and can figure things out without needing everything specified in advance.
 



  





 Technology changes quickly, and learning is part of the job. You don’t need to know our entire stack when you join, but we expect you to be curious, develop your skills and be willing to explore new tools and ways of working. You don’t need to be the most senior person in the room. We’d rather find someone with a strong foundation, good judgement and the ambition to develop quickly.
   




 About Us
 
  





 Ctrl Digital is a Swedish consultancy specialising in marketing engineering and analytics, with offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö. We are part of Havas, one of the world’s largest global communications networks.
 



 We work with companies to connect the worlds of marketing, analytics and data engineering, from measurement and server-side tracking to cloud data warehouses, data modelling, activation and AI-assisted analytics.
 



 Our consultants work closely with clients and are given significant responsibility early. At the same time, you’ll be surrounded by experienced specialists who can help you develop across analytics, cloud, marketing technology and consulting.
 



  





**We offer:** 




  




* 30 days of vacation
* Occupational pension
* Private healthcare insurance
* Wellness allowance
* Flexible working arrangements
* Continuous learning and certification opportunities
* The opportunity to work with modern data and AI technology on real client problems


 Interested?
 
  





 Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a few words about yourself.
 



  





 We’re particularly interested in hearing about something you’ve built, explored or learned recently.

title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer
description:
Deputy CTO
 



*Utvecklare med formellt ansvar* 




  





 Stockholm · Heltid, tillsvidare · Fintech under tillsyn · Noterad koncern
 



 Du har skickat kod till riktiga användare, men aldrig fått äga något på riktigt. Vi söker en utvecklare tidigt i karriären som vill ta mer ansvar än erfarenheten formellt motiverar – och vi ger dig titeln, mandatet och mentorerna som gör det möjligt.
 



  





**VAD VI BYGGER** 




**Goobit AB** 
 driver
 **BTCX** 
 , Sveriges första kryptoväxlare, i drift sedan 2012. Nu bygger vi nästa plattform:
 **Futureproof** 
 – en app där vanliga sparare lägger in pengar en gång och låter en motor sköta resten: automatiskt sparande i bitcoin, guld och traditionella tillgångar, med full insyn i varje köp, varje sälj och varje skäl. BankID-onboarding, en regelmotor som ombalanserar, en händelselogg som är systemets ryggrad. Lansering planeras inom några månader. Du kommer in innan den finns.
 



  





**ROLLEN** 




 Titeln är Deputy CTO och den är på riktigt: du bär det formella ansvaret för teknik och informationssäkerhet i Goobit AB, vårt reglerade bolag. Det är därför rollen kräver att du är anställd i Goobit AB och bor i Sverige.
 



 Vardagen är utveckling. Du skriver TypeScript för web och mobil, granskar kod, äger release-flödet och bidrar i backend och infrastruktur. Vid din sida står en tech lead och en infrastrukturansvarig som har byggt och driftat plattformen i över tio år – du skriver koden, de ser till att du inte går vilse. Ansvaret växer i takt med teamet.
 



  





*Rakt på sak: söker du ett klassiskt CTO-uppdrag med stort team och budgetansvar är det här inte rätt roll. Vill du växa fortare än någon annan arbetsgivare låter dig, är det exakt rätt.* 




  





**DU KOMMER ATT** 



* **bygga funktioner i TypeScript med React och React Native/Expo – en kodbas för iOS, Android och webb**
* **granska kod och stå för att det vi släpper till produktion håller**
* **bidra i backend (Java/Spring Boot) och infrastruktur (AWS, Terraform, PostgreSQL)**
* **äga hur vi testar, deployar och rullar tillbaka**
* **vara teknikens röst mot compliance och revision: ändringshantering, behörigheter, incidenter**
* **arbeta AI-assisterat hela vägen från prototyp till produktion**



  





**VI TROR ATT DU** 



* **bor i Sverige (krav, regulatoriskt)**
* **är stark eller på väg att bli stark i TypeScript, och nyfiken på Java och AWS**
* **har byggt något som andra använt – på jobbet, i egna projekt, i open source. Visa oss.**
* **är noggrann – här är ordning, dokumentation och spårbarhet riktig kompetens, inte pappersarbete**
* **kan förklara ett tekniskt beslut för någon utan teknisk bakgrund, på svenska och engelska**
* **Plus: mobil, DevOps, erfarenhet från bank, fintech eller annan reglerad verksamhet**



  





**DU FÅR** 



* **CTO-titel och formellt ansvar i en reglerad svensk fintech, i en noterad koncern**
* **mentorskap varje dag från två seniora ingenjörer, inte en kurs per kvartal**
* **en produkt som inte finns än – du sätter mönstren som resten av kodbasen ärver**
* **modern stack utan legacy: TypeScript, React Native/Expo, Java, AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform**
* **ett team på under tio personer där det du bygger är i kundens hand samma vecka**



  





**SÅ GÅR DET TILL** 




 Ett samtal på 30 minuter. Sedan visar du något du byggt, eller gör en kort kodövning – vi vill se hur du tänker, inte hur många algoritmer du kan. Därefter träffar du teamet. Rollen bär formellt ansvar i ett reglerat bolag, så vi gör en bakgrundskontroll i slutskedet, precis som för alla med motsvarande ansvar hos oss.
 



  





**ANSÖK** 




 Skicka CV eller LinkedIn, en länk till kod du är stolt över och några rader om varför du vill ha mer ansvar än ditt CV säger att du är redo för. Vi läser löpande och tillsätter så snart vi hittat rätt person.

title: BI Manager till Soya Group
description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för affärskritiska datalösningar och samtidigt vara med och utveckla dem för framtiden? Som BI Manager på Soya Group får du en central, tekniskt hands-on roll i en internationell koncern med verksamhet inom flera branscher.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som BI Manager får du ett stort eget ansvar för Soya Groups BI- och dataplattform. Du säkerställer en stabil och tillförlitlig drift samtidigt som du vidareutvecklar, moderniserar och framtidssäkrar den befintliga miljön. Rollen passar dig som trivs nära tekniken och vill kombinera djup BI-kompetens med ett tydligt verksamhetsperspektiv. Du kommer att arbeta i en komplex, Microsoftbaserad hybrid-miljö där datalösningarna stödjer flera verksamheter, från sjöfart och fastigheter till hållbar energi, teknik samt stuteri och gård. En viktig del av uppdraget är att förstå befintliga lösningar och beroenden, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta dem i robusta och långsiktiga lösningar.
 



  





 Rollen ingår i IS/IT-avdelningen, som ansvarar för koncernens system- och teknikstöd, support, plattformar, infrastruktur och drift, både på land och ombord på fartyg. Kontaktytorna är många och internationella, och resor utomlands kan förekomma.
 



 Ditt ansvar blir att -
 



  




* förvalta, drifta och vidareutveckla koncernens BI- och dataplattform
* säkerställa stabila dataflöden, datalager och affärskritiska schemalagda jobb
* felsöka och lösa problem i BI-lösningar i produktionsmiljö
* utveckla rapportering och datalösningar i nära dialog med verksamheten
* identifiera förbättringar och bidra till en successiv modernisering av miljön
* skapa struktur, dokument



  





**Din profil** 




 Vi söker dig som har cirka 5–7 års erfarenhet av BI och dataplattformar och är van att ta ett självständigt ansvar för utveckling, förvaltning och drift av verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Du känner dig trygg i komplexa miljöer där nyutveckling behöver kombineras med förståelse för befintliga system och legacy. Vidare -
 



  




* har du flerårig erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server i on-prem/moln-miljö
* har du arbetat med utveckling och förvaltning av datalager och ETL-processer
* har du erfarenhet av schemalagda dataflöden och affärskritiska jobb, exempelvis SQL Server Agent-jobb
* är du van vid felsökning och drift av BI-lösningar i produktionsmiljö
* har du erfarenhet av versionshantering, exempelvis Git, och moderna utvecklingsverktyg
* har du arbetat med Power BI eller ett annat rapporteringsverktyg
* uttrycker du dig flytande på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av -
 


* SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
* SSAS, multidimensionella kuber och MDX
* Visual Studio i samband med BI-utveckling, exempelvis SSIS, SSAS och SSRS
* Azure DevOps och Visual Studio Code
* PowerShell och Azure
* SharePoint Online – administration, implementation, behörighetsstrukturer och dokumenthantering
* AI, Power Automate, Power Apps eller andra verktyg för automatisering



  





 Vi söker dig som är lösningsorienterad, nyfiken och trygg i din specialistkompetens. Du tar ansvar, driver ditt arbete framåt och uppskattar samtidigt nära samarbete med kollegor, verksamhet och externa parter. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, fungerar som bollplank och ber om hjälp när det behövs. För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara serviceinriktad och affärsorienterad, med förmåga att förstå olika verksamheters behov och omsätta dem i stabila tekniska lösningar. Ett intresse för något av Soya Groups affärsområden, särskilt sjöfart eller fastigheter, är positivt.
 



  





**Om Soya Group** 




 Soya Group består av hel- och delägda företag inom sjöfart, fastigheter, hållbar energi och teknik samt stuteri och gård.  Här kombineras det mindre bolagets gemenskap med den stora koncernens möjligheter.  Du söker enkelt tjänsten via www.inhouse.se. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl och du behöver inte bifoga något personligt brev, vi är övertygade om att ditt CV räcker gott och väl.

 073-311 87 26 vid frågor

title: Senior Linux Platform Engineer
description:
**About Kambi** 




*Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners.* 




*Our vision is to create the world’s leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners.* 




 Do you want to join a growing team responsible for the layer between hardware and applications?
 



 Kambi are in the middle of a DevOps transformation and are building a sustainable organisation for the future. For our Engineering Operations department, we are searching an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer with automation skills. We are looking for people who are passionate to learning modern technologies, thrives when collaborating with others, have an agile mindset and are solution oriented.
 



**Who are we?** 




 Engineering Operations supports the infrastructure of the organisation and the success of our partners. We ensure a stable environment twenty-four seven,year-round and we like open source in all flavours. We are dedicated to agile operations, believe dev-ops and automation are great ways of achieving that, whilst using agile methodologies to support our efforts along the road.
 



 We thrive in collaborative, ever-changing environment where we are using the collective resources of the team to meet objectives and find the best solution together.
 



**The role** 




 In this role, you’ll build and maintain on-prem infrastructure with a wide variety of technologies around the globe. You’ll do this by delivering reliable, scalable, and universally available systems.
 



 Technologies we are working with today include Ubuntu, Debian, infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, NTP), globally hosted servers,
   

 virtualization (KVM), storage (Ceph), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), automation (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - reusable workflows) and private cloud environments, alongside our on-prem infrastructure.
 



**Who are you?** 




 We’re looking for a solution-oriented team player with a solid background in Linux. It is also beneficial if you have experience with infrastructure automation, basic understanding of networking (such as dynamic routing, data centre switching, site-to-site VPNs) and a “security first" approach.
 



 An agile mindset is crucial for us, and additionally experience working with Ubuntu, Debian and Puppet profiles would be a great fit within this team.
 



**You will like us if you:** 



* Think code & automation is the right way to evolve infrastructure.
* Driven and motivated to find the best solution to the problem at hand.
* Find technically complex systems thrilling.
* Detail orientated.
* Enjoy home labbing or tinkering with infrastructure in your own time.
* Enjoy working in a self-organizing, self-managing team.
* Thinks business value delivered is what defines great operations.
* Like to work within a large global environment.



**Sound like your next challenge?** 




 If you're excited by Linux, automation, and 
 **building reliable infrastructure for a global platform** 
 , we'd love to meet you.
 



**Apply now and become part of a team that's building the future of our platform.** 




***Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace***




*If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.* 




***Creating an inclusive environment***




*We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today.* 




*#wearekambi*

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
description:

 What if your engineering skills could directly shape the platforms and systems behind the AI revolution? We're looking for Senior Software Engineers in Stockholm and across Sweden to design, build, and scale the infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
   

  

 This is high-impact, technically challenging work — the kind that keeps great engineers engaged. You'll tackle real architectural problems, write code that matters, and collaborate with some of the sharpest minds in AI research and engineering.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
*We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.*
*We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?*
**Job Mission 🚀**
 As a Senior Data Scientist, you will help accelerate Data Science at Tibber by bridging the gap between advanced data science and robust production systems. You'll play a key role in building predictive data models that increase our metric of savings per kWh.
   

  

 Read more about your future leader and team here.
   

  

**What You'll Do ✅**
* Lead the ML platform build. Own the direction of our ML infrastructure: model registries, versioning, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining, and take it from good to great. This is the core of the role, especially in your first year.
* Ship models that move the metric. Develop and deploy forecasting, optimization and personalization models that plug straight into live products like Smart Charging and dynamic pricing.
* Strengthen the impact chain. We evaluate every data science service against clear goals. You'll help us take the next step: connecting model quality all the way to realized savings per kWh, through counterfactual evaluation and decision-quality metrics.
* Raise the bar with your peers. Review code, sharpen best practices and shape how a senior team works with LLM and agentic AI tools, as colleagues not students.
* Own end-to-end delivery. Drive the full lifecycle from problem framing and data sourcing to production deployment and continuous improvement.


**What We're Looking For⚡**
 You are driven by impact, enjoy fast-paced environments, and thrive when given autonomy. You've built an ML platform before and know how to go beyond models that work in a notebook to a system a team can trust.
   

  

**We Believe You'll Be a Great Fit If You**
* Have a proven track record of developing production-grade ML platforms with drift detection, model registries and CI/CD workflows, and can point to teams that shipped faster because of what you built.
* Possess deep technical skills in Python and hands-on experience with cloud ML infrastructure like Databricks MLflow, AWS SageMaker or an equivalent.
* Bring deep expertise in at least one ML domain we run in production: time-series forecasting, optimization algorithms or personalization at scale.
* Think in platforms, not patches: you build repeatable workflows and you know how to onboard a team of experienced peers into them.
* Handle ambiguity well and communicate complex data concepts clearly to product and engineering stakeholders.
* Embrace LLM and agentic AI tools as part of how modern data science gets done.
* Bonus: experience with energy time-series data, smart charging or grid optimization.


**💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️The Tibber Mindset**
 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.
   

  

 We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!
   

  

 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.
   

  

*You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.*

title: Konsult / Interim - DevSecOps
description:
**Arbeta med DevSecOps, cloud security och automation i ett uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin i Stockholm**
 Det finns miljöer där säkerhet är en viktig del av utvecklingen. Och så finns det miljöer där den måste finnas med i varje steg. I det här uppdraget inom försvarsindustrin får du som DevSecOps-konsult arbeta nära utveckling, drift och säkerhet för att bygga robusta CI/CD-flöden, automatisera infrastruktur och integrera säkerhetskontroller genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Du går in som underkonsult via Ada Digital och får ett tekniskt brett uppdrag där säkerhet inte ligger vid sidan av utvecklingen. Den byggs in från början.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Det här passar dig som gärna befinner dig där DevOps möter IT-säkerhet och som tycker om att lösa problem hands-on. Uppdragets kontext innebär höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet, samtidigt som du får använda en bred teknisk verktygslåda.
   

  

**Här Får Du Möjlighet Att**
* Arbeta brett med DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud security och Infrastructure as Code
* Kombinera automation och teknisk problemlösning med ett tydligt säkerhetsperspektiv
* Arbeta nära utvecklare, drift- och säkerhetsspecialister och påverka hur säkerhet byggs in i utvecklingsflödet
* Ta dig an ett uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin där robusthet, spårbarhet och säker utveckling har en tydlig betydelse


**Det här gör du hos oss**
 En stor del av vardagen finns i själva utvecklingskedjan. Ena stunden arbetar du djupt nere i en pipeline och funderar på var en säkerhetskontroll bäst hör hemma. Nästa stund analyserar du en sårbarhet tillsammans med utvecklare eller diskuterar hur en molnmiljö ska konfigureras för att möta säkerhetskraven.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att**
* Designa, implementera och underhålla säkra CI/CD-pipelines
* Automatisera infrastruktur och konfiguration med exempelvis Terraform och Ansible
* Integrera SAST, DAST, SCA och secrets management i utvecklingsflöden
* Arbeta med säker konfiguration och drift av AWS, Azure eller GCP, samt Docker och Kubernetes
* Genomföra säkerhetsbedömningar, identifiera sårbarheter och tillsammans med teamen hitta fungerande sätt att åtgärda dem
* Monitorera applikations- och molnmiljöer och stötta vid incidenthantering
* Bidra med vägledning kring säker arkitektur och DevSecOps-principer


**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du kommer in som specialist där du sammarbetar med andra kollegor. Uppdraget innebär tätt samarbete med utvecklare och specialister inom drift och säkerhet, med gemensamt ansvar för att få utvecklingskedjan att fungera både effektivt och säkert.
   

  

 Uppdraget är på heltid och utförs på plats i Stockholm. Du arbetar som underkonsult via Ada Digital hos vår kund inom försvarsindustrin.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 För att lyckas i rollen har du flera års arbetserfarenhet av DevOps, DevSecOps eller närliggande områden. CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code är bekanta delar av vardagen, liksom molnplattformar, containers och frågan om hur dessa konfigureras och drivs säkert.
   

  

**Du Har Även Erfarenhet Av**
* CI/CD med exempelvis Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps eller GitHub Actions
* Terraform, Ansible eller motsvarande Infrastructure as Code-verktyg
* AWS, Azure eller GCP samt Docker och Kubernetes
* SAST, DAST, SCA och secrets management
* Python, Bash, Go eller annat relevant script- eller programmeringsspråk


 Dessutom har du förståelse för säkerhetsramverk och standarder som OWASP, ISO 27001 eller NIST och känner till compliance krav som kan påverka cloud native-miljöer. Certifieringar inom cloud eller security är meriterande.
   

  

 Som person är du lösningsorienterad, analytisk och samarbetsorienterad. Du identifierar risker och problem, men stannar inte vid att konstatera dem. I stället söker du pragmatiska lösningar och kan förklara både vad som behöver göras och varför. Du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar prestigelöst till att teamet kommer framåt.
   

  

**Så här får vi kontakt**
 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag där du antingen blir anställd av oss på Ada Digital eller anlitas som underkonsult, beroende på vilken lösning som passar dig bäst. I tillsättningen strävar vi efter att ge dig en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Och vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! För att ansöka behöver du inte bifoga några dokument. Skriv istället en kort motivering och bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Urval kommer sker löpande och uppdraget kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: MarTech Specialist
description:
*Vi er Strawberry. Et voksende univers med hundrevis av hoteller, restauranter, spa og opplevelser i hele Norden, Litauen og på Færøyene. Her finner du urbane Comfort Hotel™, varme Quality Hotel™, stilfulle Clarion Hotel®, hyggelige Home Hotel og veinære Stopover – sammen med en stor samling unike og uavhengige hoteller. På hotelloppholdene sine samler gjestene våre dessuten Spenn – fleksible poeng som kan brukes på nye opplevelser. Bak det hele står titusenvis av mennesker fra hele verden, med energi, mot og entusiasme.*




 As a
 **MarTech Specialist,** 
 you will work in the MarTech Platform team to build, develop, and optimize Strawberry's marketing technology platform. You will gather technical and functional business requirements, configure platform components to support marketing strategies across the organization, and coordinate with stakeholders.
   

  





 You will contribute directly to platform development, system integrations, and the lifecycle of connected marketing tools. This role requires hands-on technical work and close collaboration with developers, architects, and business stakeholders.
   

  





 Our current MarTech stack includes:
 


* **Braze** 
 – Customer Engagement Platform
* **mParticle** 
 – Customer Data Platform
* **Dynamic Yield** 
 – Personalization Engine
* **Contentful** 
 – Content Management System



  

**MAIN TASKS / KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Develop and configure MarTech solutions to support marketing and business objectives.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Partner with solution architects and integration developers to ensure robust, scalable platform architecture.
* Ensure all MarTech components comply with data governance, privacy, and security standards.
* Maintain and enhance personalization capabilities across marketing channels.
* Provide technical support and guidance to internal marketing teams.
* Create and maintain documentation for configurations, workflows, and platform best practices.



  

**ROLE PROFILE / WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WITH** 



* 3+ years of hands-on experience in a MarTech, Marketing Operations, or similar technical role.
* Experience with platforms such as:
	+ Engagement Platforms (e.g., Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot)
	+ CDPs (e.g., mParticle, Segment, Tealium)
	+ CMS solutions (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)
	+ Personalization Engines (e.g., Dynamic Yield, Optimizely, Adobe Target)

* Experience with implementing AI pilots into live use cases.
* Ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions and clearly explain them to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a cross-functional environment.
* A builder mindset—comfortable with ambiguity, hands-on with new tools, and focused on continuous improvement.
* Dedication to improving customer engagement, personalization, and satisfaction through MarTech.
* Proactive in identifying and implementing process improvements and cost-effective best practices.
* Proficient in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues.



  

**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT** 



* Continuously identify and propose improvements to help Strawberry reach its full potential.
* Work actively to find smarter ways of working and collaborate closely with the organization to implement improvements.



 This is a 12-month project position with the possibility of extension.
   

  

 You will report to our MarTech Platform Owner within the Tech department. This position is primarily based at our HQ in Oslo or Stockholm. You will enjoy great benefits, great lunches, and fantastic colleagues. 
   

  





**SOUNDS INTERESTING?**




 If, after reading this job description, you thought, "Wow, they just described me," and felt a spark, we would love to hear from you. Applications are processed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 Any questions? Please reach out to magnus.sesseng@strawberry.no.

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:

 What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Stockholm to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
   

  

 Stockholm is one of Europe's most celebrated technology ecosystems — the city that gave the world Spotify, Klarna, and a generation of world-class engineers. Now you can bring that engineering culture to the frontier of AI development, entirely on your own schedule.
   

  

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr

title: Data Analyst - Vitamin Well Group
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.* 




 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business. We work across e-commerce, data and AI, with a clear focus on shaping the technology and capabilities that will drive how our digital business operates and grows.
 



  





 We are now looking for an
 **Data Analyst** 
 to strengthen the data foundation behind that journey. You will work across the full data lifecycle – from ingestion, modelling and quality to dashboards, analysis and operationalization – turning data into something teams can trust, understand and act on.
 



  





 This is an opportunity to join while much of our data capability is still taking shape. Rather than stepping into a finished setup, you will work closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead to influence how we structure, connect and use data across our digital business.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As an Data Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics and business. The role extends beyond building reliable data models: you will help make data accessible, actionable and valuable in driving better decisions across the business.
 



  





 You will develop reusable models and pipelines, strengthen data quality and create dashboards and self-serve analytics that give teams direct access to the metrics they need. At the same time, you will work closely with colleagues across Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Organic and Paid Social, Product and Engineering to solve real business problems with data.
 



  





 That could mean modelling customer and transaction data, connecting a new marketing data source, improving how we measure retention or LTV, or taking an open-ended business question and turning it into an analysis that leads to action.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations, with a strong focus on data quality, testing and observability.
* Develop data pipelines, ingestion and integrations across our digital data ecosystem.
* Create dashboards and self-serve analytics that enable global and local teams to access, understand and act on their KPIs.
* Translate open-ended business questions into structured models, analysis and actionable insights.
* Analyze customer behaviour and growth across the funnel, including areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.
* Contribute to documentation, governance and data best practices, while using AI-native tools to improve how we work with data and analytics.



  





 Who you are
 



 You have a relevant degree within Software Engineering, IT, Business or a related field, along with 1–4 years of professional experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Analyst or in a similar role. Ideally, you have worked across different parts of the data journey – from raw data and modelling to analysis and business application – and have a genuine interest in using data and AI to support digital sales and marketing.
 



  





 As a person, you are curious, pragmatic and eager to learn. You enjoy solving problems, are comfortable finding your way forward when not everything is defined and take ownership of moving your work forward. You also enjoy working with others and can make technical topics clear and useful to people with different backgrounds.
 



  





 We believe you have:
 


* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of analytical data modelling, with hands-on experience using transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
* Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
* Working knowledge of Python for automation and light data engineering.
* Experience working with APIs and integrations.
* Experience with dashboards, BI tools and self-serve analytics.
* Hands-on experience with AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Fluency in Swedish and English (written and verbal communication)



  





 It is a plus if you have experience with:
 


* Orchestration and data pipeline tools such as Airflow, Dagster or similar.
* Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
* AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.
* Working in a fast-moving tech company, early-stage environment or scale-up.



  





 How to apply
 



*Application deadline: October 12th 2026* 




 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
 



  





**Life at Vitamin Well Group** 




 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. description:

 Här blir du en del av enheten Dataanalys och dataplattform, som ansvarar för att tillhandahålla plattformar för lagring, analys och delning av data för att möjliggöra en säker och effektiv användning av data och information på hela myndigheten. Vi arbetar tvärfuktionellt enligt agila principer tillsammans med förvaltningsledare och produktägare med både förvaltning och vidareutveckling.
 



  





 I din roll som Systemadministratör kommer du att arbeta med förvaltning, drift och vidareutveckling av våra dataplattformar för Analytics. Du ansvarar för att dataplattformen fungerar optimalt och säkerställer att viktiga rapporter och analyser förses med korrekt data i rätt tid.  I rollen blir du en nyckelperson i att driva Svenska kraftnäts datadrivna utveckling och stärka verksamhetens förmåga att använda data som grund för beslut och insikter. Här får du goda möjligheter att påverka arbetssätt och lösningar inom givna ramar för verksamheten.

title: Undergraduate studies in Machine learning for early prediction of primary sclerosing cholangitis (scholarship)
description:
**Do you want to contribute to improving human health?**




 Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a chronic liver disease that often occurs together with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and is typically diagnosed late. Our lab use linked Swedish national health registers to develop machine-learning models that aim to identify, five years before PSC is diagnosed, which patients with IBD will develop the disease. As a scholarship student, you will work on this model with nationwide register data and learn how clinical prediction models are validated, explained and reported. Our team is multidisciplinary with clinical and methodological expertise in the field. 
   

  





****Division****




 The project is based in the Gastroenterology Unit at the Department of Medicine, Huddinge, Karolinska Institutet, Campus Flemingsberg. It is led by Ghada Nouairia, Assistant Professor in Computational Oncology, whose research focuses on PSC, cholangiocarcinoma and gallbladder cancer, and on clinically applicable prediction models that integrate registry and electronic health record data, medical imaging and molecular biomarkers.
   

  





 The study links the National Patient Register, the Prescribed Drug Register, the Cause of Death Register, the Swedish Cancer Register and population data from Statistics Sweden to follow patients with IBD from their first healthcare contacts until a PSC diagnosis. The work is carried out together with hepatologists and a biostatistician.
   

  





****Duties (of the scholarship student)****




 You will take part in the validation and reporting of the PSC prediction model. The tasks will be set out in an individual research plan, adapted to the length of the scholarship period, and may include:
 


* Data quality and cohort description: checking that every predictor is derived only from information recorded before the prediction time point, documenting how each feature was constructed, and preparing descriptive tables of the study cohort.
* Validation analyses in R or Python, such as bootstrap confidence intervals, calibration of predicted risks, and model performance across age groups and at different times before diagnosis.
* Figures, including receiver operating characteristic (ROC) and precision–recall curves, enrichment curves showing the share of future PSC cases captured, and model explanations based on SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
* A structured literature review on PSC in IBD and on existing PSC prediction models, and mapping the study against the TRIPOD+AI reporting guideline for clinical prediction models.
* Writing documented, reproducible analysis code.



****Eligibility requirements****




 These scholarships aim to provide students at the undergraduate level with early practical experience of research work, in order to strengthen the link between education and research and encourage future studies at the doctoral level.
   

  





 The scholarships can be granted either for studies in an existing course or for a shorter period of practical research experience (documented in an individual study plan/research plan) for admitted students at the undergraduate or graduate level. The scholarships may be awarded for up to 12 months (divided into a maximum of four courses/periods) during the study period. Decisions on scholarships may be made for a maximum of six months at a time.
   

  





 The scholarships may be granted only to: persons who have been admitted (and registered in Ladok) to KI to study at the undergraduate or graduate level, persons who are admitted (and registered) to undergraduate or graduate level programs at a university with which KI collaborates.
   

  





**Skills and personal qualities**




  
 **Required:** 



* Studies in data science, machine learning engineering or a closely related field.
* Good programming skills in R and Python.
* Clear communication and documentation skills to be able to explain and replicate research findings.
* Good timekeeping skills and an ability to work in a team or independently.



**Meritious:** 



* Earlier experience with registry data.
* Experience or knowledge on PSC and/or biliary tract cancers.



****What do we offer?****




 A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Here, we conduct innovative medical research and provide the largest range of biomedical education in Sweden. At KI, you get to meet researchers working with a wide range of specialisms and methods, giving you ample opportunity to exchange knowledge and experience with the various scientific fields within medicine and health. It is the crossover collaborations, which have pushed KI to where it is today, at the forefront of global research. Several of the people you meet in healthcare are educated at KI. A close relationship with the health care providers is important for creating groundbreaking top quality education and research. Students and employees have free access to our modern gym facilities with trained staff on site.
   

  





**Location:** 
 Flemingsberg
   

  





****Application process****




*An* 
*application* 
*must* 
*contain* 
*the* 
*following* 
*documents* 
*in* 
*English* 
*:* 



* *A complete curriculum vitae,*
* *A summary of current work (no more than one page)*



 The application is to be submitted on the Varbi recruitment system.
   

  





**Want to make a difference? Join us and contribute to better health for all**

title: Engineering Manager | Streaming Delivery
description:
När någon startar TV4 Play eller MTV Katsomo ska videon fungera. Oavsett om det handlar om en direktsänd fotbollsmatch, ett nyhetsinslag eller nästa avsnitt av en serie.
   

  

 Streaming Delivery ansvarar för tekniken som gör det möjligt.
   

  

 Teamet arbetar med hela leveranskedjan för live och VOD: transkodering och paketering, multi-CDN, server-side ad insertion, skydd mot piratkopiering, codecs, redundans och tillförlitlig videoleverans.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en
 **Engineering Manager** 
 som tillsammans med teamet vill fortsätta utveckla både tekniken och hur vi arbetar.
   

  

**Uppdraget**
 Streaming Delivery består idag av fyra utvecklare med djup teknisk och domänmässig kompetens.
   

  

 Det finns mycket kunskap och erfarenhet att bygga vidare på. Samtidigt utvecklar vi delar av vår streamingplattform, stärker redundansen i liveleveransen, fortsätter arbetet med SSAI och skydd mot piratkopiering och förändrar hur vi utvecklar mjukvara med hjälp av AI och agentiska arbetssätt.
   

  

 Som Engineering Manager får du en central roll i den förflyttningen. Tillsammans med teamet skapar du riktning och förutsättningar för att utveckla både teknik, arbetssätt och kompetens över tid.
   

  

**Vad du kommer att göra**
 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* leda teamet och skapa tydlighet kring mål, ansvar och individuell utveckling
* tillsammans med teamet utveckla samarbete och arbetssätt
* vara ett tekniskt bollplank i arkitekturfrågor och komplexa tekniska vägval
* tillsammans med Product Manager koppla tekniska prioriteringar till tittarupplevelse och affärsvärde
* bidra till en långsiktigt hållbar kompetensmix
* bidra till hur teamet arbetar med AI-assisterad och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling


 Du behöver inte vara den främsta streamingexperten i rummet. Däremot behöver du ha en tillräckligt stark teknisk grund för att förstå problemen, ställa relevanta frågor och bidra till kvalificerade tekniska diskussioner.
   

  

**Vad teamet arbetar med**
 Streaming Delivery ansvarar bland annat för:
   

  

* transkodering och paketering av live- och VOD-innehåll för adaptive bitrate streaming
* multi-CDN och balansering av videoleverans
* server-side ad insertion för live och VOD
* redundans och reservlösningar för liveleveransen
* skydd mot piratkopiering och obehörig åtkomst till innehåll
* codecs, bitrates och andra parametrar som påverkar videokvaliteten
* övervakning, felhantering och Streaming Reliability Engineering
* utvärdering av ny teknik inom video och ljud


 Vi använder bland annat vårt interna mått
 **Absolutely Flawless Streams (AFS)** 
 för att följa hur stor andel av våra streams som levereras utan problem för tittaren.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Du har erfarenhet av att leda utvecklare med personalansvar och är trygg i de olika delarna av ledarskapet: utveckling, stöd, återkoppling, prestation och de svårare samtal som ibland ingår i chefsrollen.
   

  

 Du har själv en teknisk bakgrund och ett fortsatt genuint intresse för teknik. Du behöver inte skriva mest kod, men du ska kunna diskutera arkitektur, tillförlitlighet och tekniska vägval med seniora utvecklare och förstå konsekvenserna av olika beslut.
   

  

 Du har arbetat med komplexa system i produktion där stabilitet, kvalitet och tillgänglighet spelar stor roll.
   

  

 Du har också erfarenhet av att leda i förändring och är bekväm med att arbeta i en miljö där det redan finns mycket kunskap, erfarenhet och tydliga perspektiv. Du kan bygga förtroende och tillsammans med teamet skapa riktning när teknik eller arbetssätt behöver förändras.
   

  

 Erfarenhet från streaming, video, distribuerade system, molntjänster, plattform eller andra miljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet och tillförlitlighet är meriterande.
 **Du behöver inte komma från mediebranschen.**
**Om TV4 och MTV**
 TV4 och MTV är en del av Schibsted och tillsammans bygger vi några av Nordens mest använda streamingtjänster.
   

  

 Inom Product, Tech & Operations arbetar utvecklare, produktchefer, designers och dataspecialister tillsammans i tvärfunktionella team med stort ansvar för både problemen de löser och lösningarna de bygger.
   

  

 Streaming Delivery arbetar över Sverige och Finland och påverkar direkt upplevelsen för människor som använder TV4 Play och MTV Katsomo varje dag.
   

  

**Vad TV4 erbjuder**
* Ett tekniskt komplext uppdrag med direkt påverkan på våra streamingtjänster
* Ett erfaret team med djup specialistkompetens
* Stor möjlighet att påverka hur området utvecklas
* 30 dagars semester
* Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar och friskvårdsbidrag
* Kontor i Stockholm med gym och restaurang


**Praktisk information**
 TV4 är office first och vi arbetar normalt från kontoret fyra dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

 Facklig tillhörighet: Unionen. Kontakta unionen@tv4.se för frågor.
   

  

 Bakgrundskontroll ingår i processen.
   

  

**Ansökan och process**
 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och intervjuer, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Domain Architect
description:
What we do at Qliro
   

  

 At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 `We are looking for a Domain Architect to shape the technological landscape of our domain - the glue between teams, infrastructure and products. You own the architecture end to end, keeping it robust, cost-efficient, scalable and aligned with Qliro's long-term vision.
   

  

 Working with our Tech Leads and Product Managers, you set technical direction across team boundaries and make sure architectural strategy is written down, communicated and executed. You facilitate and coach rather than implement - teams keep ownership of their systems, and you stay clear of day-to-day product work. Our Tech Leads are looking for someone they can learn from: someone senior to think through solutions and ADRs with, who guides them to the best answer and shares their experience. This is a 100% architecture role with no managerial responsibility - you'll be part of Qliro's Tech management team, reporting to the CTO.
   

  

**What You'll Focus On First**
* Building a clear, shared view of Qliro's architecture - all services, systems and external dependencies - published centrally and maintained by teams to a common standard
* Establishing a target architecture and decision framework that supports market expansion and volume growth without revisiting fundamental decisions each time
* Defining domain boundaries and ownership together with Product - bounded contexts aligned to business capabilities, an accountable owner for every system, and a clear cross-team decision process (when an ADR is needed, and who approves it)
* Using that shared picture to spot duplication, weak boundaries and problematic dependencies - then prioritizing and driving the most important cross-domain improvements
* Driving the system design phase of larger cross-team initiatives - framing the problem, bringing the right teams together early in feature discovery rather than late, and keeping ownership clear
* Setting shared standards with the Tech Leads: API guidelines, development principles and documentation practices, so teams build in a uniform way


**What We Are Looking For**
* You have designed and run distributed systems in production - components, data flows, interfaces, deployment topology
* You have owned non-functional requirements and made the trade-offs behind them visible
* You communicate architecture clearly in English - in writing, diagrams and in the room
* You know how domains intersect - you can tell early in discovery which teams a feature will touch, where blockers live and who should be involved
* You guide and coach teams to sound architecture without taking decision-making or ownership away from them
* You balance product speed against platform scalability - and can explain the trade-off to both sides


**It is beneficial if you have experience from:**
* Working in a regulated, high-availability environment - payments/FinTech is a plus, not required
* Domain-driven design in practice - mapping bounded contexts with business stakeholders
* Modernizing legacy workflows and consolidating duplicated capabilities


**Does this sound like your next role? What are you waiting for – apply now!**
