Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av rekrytering inom IT och tech. Du förstår den tekniska kandidatmarknaden och är van vid att självständigt hitta, kontakta och attrahera kandidater.


Vi tror att du har:

* Erfarenhet av att driva rekryteringsprocesser inom tech
* God erfarenhet av search och headhunting
* Erfarenhet av LinkedIn Recruiter och Teamtailor
* Förmåga att självständigt driva flera rekryteringsprocesser parallellt
* Utbildning inom personalvetenskap, HR eller annat närliggande område
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

### **För att trivas på Skandit**


Vi tror att du trivs bäst hos oss om du gillar att arbeta i ett mindre och växande bolag där alla bidrar och där det finns stora möjligheter att påverka.


Du är självgående, driven och initiativtagande. Du väntar inte på att någon annan ska driva arbetet framåt, utan tar ansvar för dina processer och ser vad som behöver göras.


Samtidigt tycker du om att arbeta med människor och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både kunder och kandidater.


Vi ser gärna att du har en entreprenöriell sida och tycker att det är kul att få vara med och utveckla ett bolag – inte bara arbeta inom ramarna för en färdig roll.

### **Ansökan**


Vi söker någon som kan börja omgående eller enligt överenskommelse och vi kommer att hantera ansökningar löpande.


Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen och vill arbeta med teknisk rekrytering i ett mindre bolag där du får stort eget ansvar? Skicka in din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Platform Engineer - DevEx
description:
* Ansök senast: 7 oktober 2026
* Stockholm
* Hybrid
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

*Vill du bygga utvecklingsplattformen som hundratals utvecklare på Länsförsäkringar förlitar sig på varje dag? Vi söker dig som drivs av automation, cloud och effektiva utvecklingsflöden, och som vill skapa en utvecklingsplattform där säkerhet, hastighet och utvecklarupplevelse går hand i hand. Hos oss får du möjlighet att forma utvecklarupplevelsen i en organisation där innovation, samarbete och samhällsnytta står i fokus.*


**Om rollen:**



Som Platform Engineer blir du en nyckelperson i vår plattformsleverans inom DevEx. Du får vara med och vidareutveckla och förvalta vår utvecklingsplattform samt ta den till nästa nivå i vår DevSecOps-satsning. Ditt fokus kommer att vara att säkerställa regelefterlevnad och förmågor för applikationssäkerhetstestning (SAST/DAST/SCA). Med vår Internal Developer Platform (IDP) skapar vi moderna, automatiserade CI/CD-pipelines som gör det möjligt för utvecklingsteam att snabbt och säkert bygga, testa och driftsätta applikationer. Du arbetar nära produktteam, säkerhetsarkitekter och övriga arkitekter för att driva DevSecOps-principer och continuous delivery i hela kedjan.


**Du kommer att:**


* Bygga och vidareutveckla vår IDP med fokus på self-service, automation och skalbarhet.
* Designa och implementera robusta DevSecOps-lösningar i Azure Cloud (AWS är ett plus).
* Automatisera allt från releasehantering till deployment och monitoring.
* Integrera säkerhet och compliance i leveranskedjan (Shift Left).
* Vara med och bidra till roadmap för plattformen.
* Dela kunskap och bidra till våra tekniska communitys.


**Tekniker du arbetar med dagligen:** Azure, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, Checkmarx, Sonatype Suite (Nexus RM, Nexus IQ-Firewall) och moderna CI/CD-verktyg.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Personalvillkor på bolån och blancolån
* Rabatt på sak-, person- och djurförsäkring
* Friskvårdsbidrag och friskvårdstimma
* Gym & gruppträning på kontoret
* Lunchförmån
* Fyra extra lediga dagar/år utöver semesterdagarna
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

Vi söker dig som är tekniskt kompetent, nyfiken och har ett öga för helheten. Du gillar att bygga skalbara plattformar, skapa struktur och förbättra utvecklarupplevelsen – och du trivs i en roll där teknik, säkerhet och samarbete går hand i hand. Du är en doer som får saker att hända, har integritet och gillar att jobba i agila team där innovation och förbättring är en del av vardagen.


**Vi tror att du har:**


* Gedigen erfarenhet av systemutveckling och DevSecOps.
* Djup kunskap om Azure Cloud och dess plattformstjänster (AKS, App Service, Key Vault m.fl.).
* Praktisk erfarenhet av container-orkestrering med Kubernetes eller OpenShift, samt containerisering med Docker.
* Gedigen erfarenhet av CI/CD och pipeline-automation – du har byggt robusta leveransflöden i produktion.
* Erfarenhet av infrastruktur som kod (IaC) med t.ex. Terraform, ARM/Bicep eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller arbeta med Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) och self-service-lösningar.
* Förmåga att skapa en riktigt bra developer experience och stödja utvecklingsteam.
* Erfarenhet av att integrera säkerhet i CI/CD-pipelines – exempelvis applikationssäkerhetstestning (SAST/DAST), hemlighetshantering och policy enforcement.
* Erfarenhet av att jobba i agila ramverk, gärna SAFe.
* Stark teknisk kommunikationsförmåga – du kan både förklara och fördjupa beroende på målgrupp.
* Affärsmässighet och kostnadsmedvetenhet – du hittar lösningar som skapar värde för både verksamheten och kunden.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas.


**Extra plus om du har:**


* Erfarenhet av AWS och hybrid cloud-miljöer.
* Fördjupad erfarenhet av Sonatype Products (Nexus RM, Nexus IQ – Firewall), Checkmarx och Backstage.
* Kunskap om observability, metrics och monitoring.
* Erfarenhet av GitOps, eventdriven arkitektur och serverless.
* Bakgrund från plattformsdriven utveckling i större organisationer.


**Kontaktpersoner**  

Rekryterande chef: Charlotta.Haldin@lansforsakringar.se  

Facklig representant Forena: jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se  

Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Lisa-Maria.Carensjo@lansforsakringar.se

Process and Dev Tools är en del av Digital Solution & Operation Platform (DSOP) inom vår IT-organisation Digital & IT. Vi arbetar enligt SAFe, med en tydlig vision att skapa en hållbar och effektiv produktutveckling – där DevSecOps är en självklar grundförutsättning



Teamet består idag av Product Manager, Product Owners, DevSecOps Engineers, Scrum Masters och Process Owner som tillsammans ansvarar för våra förmågor och processer för IT-utveckling. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande laganda med högt i tak och stora möjligheter till utveckling.


  
Charlotta Haldin | Kontaktperson

title: Data and Analytics Project Manager
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Data and Analytics Project Manager on behalf of one of our partner companies. You know that data programmes depend as much on definitions, ownership and adoption as on pipelines and platforms.
  
The partner is building a modern analytics capability across business functions. You will coordinate platform, data product and reporting work while making sure that source ownership, quality and decision use remain visible throughout delivery.
  
Technology delivery is treated as organisational change with technical consequences. The partner expects one coherent view across architecture, security, data, suppliers, users and operations from initial scope through stable ownership.
  
How you will work
  
You will work across business owners, technical specialists, security, operations and external suppliers. The partner expects you to understand enough detail to test the plan, while keeping technical accountability with the appropriate experts. Ownership continues through cutover, stabilisation and handover.
  
As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. Seniority here means broader judgement and follow through, not distance from delivery.
  
What you will do
  
Create the data programme plan, governance and release roadmap.
  
  

Coordinate engineers, analysts, architects and business owners.
  
  

Manage source dependencies, data quality and access decisions.
  
  

Drive definition alignment and data product acceptance.
  
  

Control suppliers, risks, budget and executive reporting.
  
  

Plan adoption, support and ownership after release.
  
  

What you will bring
  
Senior IT or data project management experience.
  
  

Understanding of data platforms, integration and analytics delivery.
  
  

Strong dependency and stakeholder management skills.
  
  

Experience establishing data ownership and acceptance.
  
  

Ability to manage agile work within programme governance.
  
  

Professional English and precise decision communication.
  
  

Experience that would add value
  
Azure data platforms, Databricks or cloud warehouses.
  
  

Data governance and master data.
  
  

AI or advanced analytics initiatives.
  
  

A background that can succeed here
  
Your background may be data delivery, business intelligence, IT programme management or analytics consulting. You do not need to design the architecture, but you must understand why unclear definitions and unmanaged source changes can defeat a technically successful build.
  
What makes the opportunity interesting
  
The role offers the chance to create a capability used across the organisation. You will connect technical delivery with trusted information and help teams move from isolated reports toward owned, reusable data products.
  
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.
  
The recruitment conversation
  
During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional credential if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.
  
How to apply
  
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant organisation, service, project or financial process you have helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into the profession and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: Master’s Thesis at KPMG Cyber Security Jan 2027
description:
* Application Deadline: Oct. 11, 2026
* Multiple locations
**Job Description**
-------------------

*Are you interested in being mentored by Cyber Security consultants within your research field, and develop skills that will help you write a master thesis? KPMG Cyber Security offers students an opportunity to write their master thesis at our Stockholm and Gothenburg offices this spring.*


**Writing your master thesis at KPMG Cyber is an excellent way to broaden your knowledge within Cyber and get to know the consulting profession. You will be assigned an experienced consultant and a senior sponsor with knowledge in your industry of interest, who will be your personal advisor from the beginning of your thesis process to the** **end of your thesis defense.**

**KPMG Cyber Security**:



As a Cyber Security consultant at KPMG, we are part of a global team working across various industries and areas, collaborating with inspiring colleagues and experts in the field. We work shoulder to shoulder with top executives, advising them on how to tackle their security challenges in an efficient and ethical way.



We support our clients in everything from establishing a cyber security strategy to implementing and ensuring compliance with requirements. Our services cover governance, operational technology and incident management.


By joining our team, you will become a part of a tight knit group of approximately 35 professionals from diverse backgrounds, including computer science, political science, law, law enforcement, criminology, and many more. The diversity enriches our team, enabling us to approach cyber security challenges from multiple perspectives and develop comprehensive solutions. Our team consists of experts within cyber security areas such as ISMS, IAM, cyber defense and response, privacy, physical security, cloud security and other cyber related competencies.


**What do we offer?**  

Our master thesis program is a one-semester opportunity that starts in January. During the master thesis period at KPMG Cyber Security, your assigned advisor will challenge your thought process and provide insights into your problems and solutions. Furthermore, you will get a great chance to build a network within KPMG. As part of our master thesis program, you will also be invited to social activities with the team! KPMG have a hybrid way of working, but we encourage our thesis writers to be at the office in central Stockholm or Gothenburg.



**Work with great people**
--------------------------

Julia Blomqvist
Deal Advisory
*"The 3 best things about working at KPMG are: The people: Ambitious colleagues who become friends. Responsibility: Significant from day one, fostering growth. Development: Constantly improving in a supportive environment."*
Oscar Allgulander
Capital Markes
*"What I value most at KPMG is working alongside highly competent colleagues, being continuously challenged in my assignments, and experiencing a steep learning curve that drives my professional development"*
**Skills & Requirements**
-------------------------

**Join us**



We are looking for one high performing and talented individual who are planning to graduate in the first half of 2027 from relevant fields e.g., IT, engineering, information security, law etc. We require fluency in English, Swedish with permit to work in sweden.



As we are a diverse team with different backgrounds, we are always interested in exploring how cyber security and information security can be applied across different industries. Therefore, we encourage you to propose thesis topics that align with your personal area of interest.



In the past, master’s students writing their thesis at KPMG Cyber Security have explored topics such as ISMS assessment and implementation, NIS2-directive and other cyber security regulations, IAM solutions and strategies, AI and privacy, approaches for enhancing organizational security practices, and governance frameworks for cybersecurity.



Apply no later than 11 of October. Please attach your CV and 2-3 suggestions of master thesis topics. The program will start in January 2027.



If you have any questions, please contact robin.andreasson@kpmg.se


**We look forward to your application!**



KPMG Cyber Security

title: Sr Detection Engineer II
description:
**Senior Security Detection & Automation Engineer**


**Role Overview**



We are looking for a Senior Security Detection & Automation Engineer with 4 to 8 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience.



This role focuses on designing high-quality security detections, building scalable automation, integrating security technologies, and improving the efficiency and effectiveness of security monitoring. This is an core security position, not a Tier 1 or Tier 2 alert-monitoring role.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Detection Engineering**


* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain security detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, network, email, and application environments.
* Translate threat intelligence, attacker behaviors, threat-hunting findings, and security risks into actionable detection logic.
* Develop behavioral, anomaly-based, and correlation-based detections across multiple data sources.
* Create detection content using Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA, Suricata, or platform-specific query languages.
* Map detection coverage to MITRE ATT&CK and identify gaps across priority attack techniques and critical assets.
* Tune detections to improve fidelity, reduce false positives, and minimize unnecessary analyst workload.
* Define detection requirements, including data dependencies, logic, severity, confidence, response guidance, and ownership.
* Manage the complete detection lifecycle, from initial development through validation, deployment, maintenance, and retirement.
* Measure detection quality through coverage, precision, alert volume, false-positive rates, and detection performance.


**Security Automation**


* Design and develop automation for alert enrichment, correlation, prioritization, evidence collection, case creation, and analyst recommendations.
* Automate repetitive Tier 1 and Tier 2 activities to improve analyst capacity and consistency.
* Build integrations between SIEM, EDR, XDR, SOAR, identity, cloud, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, ticketing, and communication platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts, APIs, services, connectors, and automation components using Python, PowerShell, or comparable languages.
* Implement reliable workflows with error handling, retry logic, logging, monitoring, auditability, and failure notifications.
* Apply appropriate access controls, secrets management, testing, approval points, and rollback capabilities.
* Evaluate AI-assisted security workflows with appropriate validation, evidence tracking, security controls, and human oversight.
* Measure automation value through reduced handling time, improved consistency, lower manual effort, and increased analyst capacity.


**Detection-as-Code**


* Manage detection content through version-controlled detection-as-code practices.
* Build automated pipelines for detection validation, testing, deployment, and rollback.
* Create unit tests, regression tests, and simulation-based tests for detection logic.
* Validate detections against representative attack data and expected business activity.
* Conduct peer reviews of detection rules and automation code.
* Maintain clear documentation covering detection purpose, logic, telemetry requirements, ATT&CK mapping, testing evidence, known limitations, and response guidance.
* Monitor changes to schemas, data sources, APIs, and security platforms that may affect detection or automation reliability.


**Security Research and Continuous Improvement**


* Research emerging attacker techniques, security technologies, and detection opportunities relevant to the organization.
* Perform threat hunting and controlled attack simulations to validate detection coverage.
* Identify telemetry gaps and work with technology owners to improve security data quality and visibility.
* Develop reusable engineering standards, libraries, templates, and frameworks.
* Review existing alerts and workflows to identify opportunities for tuning, consolidation, or automation.
* Provide technical guidance on detection logic, telemetry interpretation, and automated workflows.
* Convert security risks and control gaps into measurable engineering improvements.


**Required Experience**


* 4 to 8 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience, with significant exposure to detection engineering, security automation, threat hunting, SOC engineering, or security engineering.
* Demonstrated experience creating, testing, and tuning production security detections.
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise SIEM platform and one EDR or XDR platform.
* Practical scripting or software development experience using Python, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
* Experience building API-based integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and structured security data.
* Experience with Git, peer review, automated testing, and controlled deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of endpoint, identity, cloud, network, email, and application security telemetry.
* Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and common adversary behaviors.
* Ability to distinguish malicious activity from expected business and system behavior.
* Ability to convert a security requirement into a tested, maintainable, and measurable engineering solution.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.

  

That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.

 **What you will do**

* The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.
* Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.
* The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.
* The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.
* The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.

 **Where you will do it**  

Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.

  

If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 **Who you are**

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

* **6+ years** deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.
* **Kubernetes at configuration depth:** how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.
* **Identity and SSO fundamentals:** OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.
* **Linux, networking and TLS:** DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.
* **Kubernetes storage:** persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.
* **A production deployment you personally carried and then supported.** Name it, date it, tell us what went wrong.
* **Professional customer-facing English**, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.


Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 **You Get**

* Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.
* Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.
* Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.
* Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.
* Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.
* Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 **Where You Will Be**

* Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich
* Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe
* Start date: ASAP

### **We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.**

title: Marketing & Communications Lead, B2B
description:
### **One group. Four specialized companies. 0 marketing fluff.**


At Playground Group, we don’t do generic corporate chatter. Over the last few years, we’ve grown into a 120-person strong collective of high-craft builders across **Playground Consulting, Tech, Dev, and Data**. We help some of Sweden’s most ambitious brands navigate everything from AI engineering and cloud architecture to complex data platforms and management consulting.


Here’s the reality: **we’ve built an incredible tech engine, but we’ve never had a dedicated lead for marketing and communications.**


Until now.


We are looking for a **Marketing & Communications Lead (B2B)** to step in, own the canvas, and build our group-wide marketing function from scratch. Reporting directly to our Head of Sales, you’ll be the bridge between technical excellence, partner ecosystems, and real-world business development.


No 50-page strategy decks that sit in a drawer. No bureaucratical sign-off chains. Just sharp positioning, high-impact partner campaigns, and B2B marketing that actually moves the needle.

### **What you’ll do**


This is a **solo-role with strategic weight and full execution freedom**. You won't be managing an internal army. You’re an agile operator who owns the strategy, executes hands-on, and brings in external agencies or freelancers when you need extra muscle.


Your days will be split across four core focus areas:

* **Sales-Supporting Activities (Priority #1):** You’ll drive activities that directly support Sales, often together with our tech partners (AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, etc., like breakfast seminars, technical panels, and co-marketed B2B campaigns that build pipeline and move deals forward. You know how to unlock partner budgets (MDF) along the way, but the goal is always sales impact, not the funding itself
* **B2B Brand Packaging & Web:** You’ll package our (AI Dev, Cloud Tech, Data Platforms, and Strategy/Managment Consulting) technical capabilities into clear, compelling offerings. You’ll own our web presence and define how we sound to decision-makers without losing the deep craft our engineers pride themselves on
* **Organic Content & Social:** You’ll drive our organic channels, particularly LinkedIn. You’ll arm our sales leads, Key Account Managers, Founders, and Product Owners with the narratives, case studies, and content they need to open doors
* **Internal & Employer Branding (Comms):** You’ll keep our 120+ colleagues aligned across our companies, making sure our internal voice matches our external positioning. And no, going with "We're like a family!" does not cut it

### **Who you are (and who you’re NOT)**


We want that rare hybrid: a strategic brand thinker who still loves opening up a blank document and writing sharp copy.

**You’re a fit if:**

* **You have 5–10+ years of B2B marketing experience**, ideally within tech, IT consulting, or fast-paced B2B environments. *(Medior or Senior—we adapt the scope to your seniority)*
* **You know how B2B sales cycles work.** You see marketing as a growth partner to sales, not a silo that produces pretty flyers nobody uses
* **You’ve run partner marketing & offline events.** You know how MDF budgets work, and you can take an event concept from a napkin sketch to a room full of CTOs and tech leads
* **You write crisp English and Swedish.** You know how to translate complex technical concepts into punchy, human narratives
* **You know how to direct external agencies.** You’re comfortable buying specialized help *(design, performance, PR)* when production demands it

**Who this role is NOT for:**

* **Empire Builders:** If you require a team of 5 junior marketers underneath you to get work done, you’ll be frustrated here. This is a hands-on builder role
* **Paid-Media Addicts:** If your main playbook is burning 500k SEK a month on Google Ads, this isn’t it. Our focus is organic B2B authority, PR, events, and partner ecosystems
* **Corporate Buzzword Enthusiasts:** We don't do "synergistic paradigm shifts." If you can't explain a concept simply, it won't pass here

### **Why you, why now?**

* **A Blank Canvas:** You get to build the marketing voice for a 120-person, high-growth group from the ground up, with full trust from leadership.
* **High Craft, Low Ego:** You’ll sit at Gamla Brogatan 27 in central Stockholm alongside brilliant, humble engineers, consultants, and leaders who genuinely care about what they build.
* **Direct Impact:** Your work directly helps our team win new clients, launch new products, and position Playground as a top-tier tech powerhouse in the Nordics.
* **Freedom with Accountability:** We care about outcomes, not hours spent in a swivel chair.

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is a breeze!

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, we'd love to see what you have done and are proud of in the marketing sphere!

**Important notes:**

* Playground Group does *not*provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent *and*independent right to work in Sweden and reside in the Stockholm area
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out

### **Welcome to Playground!**


At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.


Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.


Buzz: Marketing, Branding, Comms, Employer Branding, Recruitment Marketing, Growth Hacking, Paid Media, Socials, Content Creation, B2B Marketer

title: Founding Account Executive, Nordics
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a* 
*private, global, multi-cloud IP network* 
*, to bringing* 
*hyperlocal edge* 
*technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*
*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*
*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
 We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in the Nordics. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.
   

  

 You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
   

  

 This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in France and the Nordics, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.
   

  

*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE* 
 — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
   

  

*Forward Deployed Engineer* 
 — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
   

  

 We sell the
 *workload* 
 , not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts across France and the Nordics (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland), narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential
* Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners
* Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close
* Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"
* Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development
* Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end
* Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer
* Build local references and case studies across Paris, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo, and Helsinki
* Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises


**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into French and/or Nordic markets — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure
* Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)
* Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review
* Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling
* Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers
* Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)
* Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)
* Excellent written and verbal communication English. You listen before you pitch.
* Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role
* Based in Stockholm — this is a hybrid role with travel across the Nordics


*Bonus Points For*
* Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in the Nordics
* Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs
* C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including Nordic enterprises (Ericsson, Nokia, Telia, Telenor, AstraZeneca, Spotify, Klarna, Equinor, Novo Nordisk, Maersk)
* Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms
* Established relationships in the Nordic enterprise ecosystem — fintech, telecom, luxury/retail, aerospace/defense, healthcare, or SaaS
* Nordic language skills (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish) for the Stockholm/Copenhagen/Oslo/Helsinki markets
* Experience selling across multiple European markets with different regulatory and procurement environments

title: Product Manager - AI
description:
**About Us**
**nShift** 
 is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.
   

  

 Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!
   

  

 If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.
   

  

**About You**
 You value freedom and responsibility under accountability. You take ownership of the full product journey end to end, and you're comfortable being the "spider in the web" — the person everything connects through. You're comfortable making the hard decisions that keep the team focused on the strategic outcomes that matter.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* AI first mindset. You reach for your AI toolbox by default — building and deploying prototypes with coding agents, and using AI to speed up research, customer insight, and spec writing.
* Solid technical fluency — comfortable in architecture and API discussions with engineering
* The ability to quickly acquire the necessary domain knowledge in freight and logistics. You either come with knowledge from before or with a proven ability to quickly learn about a new domain.
* 3+ years delivering B2B SaaS product(s). A track record of getting products to market, not just planning them.
* A collaborative, energizing presence. You bring people along rather than pushing through
* Professional in writing and verbal English: you'll present to leadership, write specs, and run stakeholder discovery.


 AI first mindset. You approach every task with your AI tool box in mind, figuring out how to best leverage AI agents to be successful.
   

  

**Purpose of Role**
 nShift is looking for a Product Manager for the team that owns nShift Companion — our in-house AI agent — along with a portfolio of platform services powering our customer-facing products.
   

  

 Companion is where our product vision becomes concrete: intent-driven AI agents that understand what a customer is trying to accomplish and solve it, instead of handing them a documentation link and a support queue. This is a high-ownership role at the core of how nShift's own product teams build on shared infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with engineering and internal product teams to resolve ambiguity and hold the line on prioritization even when it's uncomfortable. Platform work is often invisible until it breaks — your job is to make deliberate trade-offs between stability, the velocity of teams building on top of you, and where Companion should extend the platform's reach, without trying to do everything at once.
   

  

 You'll work in an environment where AI is part of how we think and operate — using it to sharpen research, synthesize customer signals, and move faster without adding headcount. Comfort with AI tools isn't a nice-to-have here; it's how good PMs at nShift get leverage.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Companion & Agent Vision — Own Companion end to end and drive our vision of intent-driven AI agents solving customer problems. Decide what Companion takes on next — and what it deliberately doesn't.
* Vision & Roadmap — Deeply understanding customer workflows, pain points, customization needs, and what "good" looks like; own the roadmap end-to-end and use AI to surface signal, not wait for it.
* AI-Native Execution — Prototype to validate before engineering commits, automate competitive and customer synthesis, and spec intent and outcomes rather than fixed requirements.[JH1]
* Platform Services — Own the roadmap for a portfolio of platform services powering nShift's customer-facing products. Keep them reliable and useful to the teams building on them.
* Product Ownership — Collaborate closely with engineering to make the decisions that drive efficient development and create meaningful progress.

The team and more importantly this role will provide support, training, documentation, and professional services across the Nordic region and supports global operations for the Unison product line. The role also performs testing, evaluations, documentation development, and supports enhancement of new and existing products and solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Manage support cases from intake through resolution.
* Deliver technical and user training to employees, partners, resellers, and customers.
* Administer support portals and product catalogues.
* Perform testing, beta testing, and maintain manuals and technical documentation.
* Provide on-site support and upgrades as part of professional services.
* Support product quality, customer migrations, and future product requirements.
* Act as a technical advisor in complex projects and drive resolution of product defects.



  





**Requirements** 




  





 You have a genuine interest in IT infrastructure and several years of experience working with networking, server and client environments, virtualization technologies, and Microsoft SQL Server. You thrive in an environment where you can combine operational work, problem-solving, and technical development. We are looking for someone with solid knowledge and hands-on experience in:
 



  




* Networking (switches, routers, firewalls, and TCP/IP)
* Server and client environments (Windows and/or Linux)
* Virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, or Nutanix
* Microsoft SQL Server administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting
* Minimum 8 years of industry experience preferably within the Security Business and /or IT



  





 Education & Competencies
 



  




* Minimum secondary school qualification; university degree preferred.
* Proven experience in networking, server/client infrastructure, virtualization, and Microsoft SQL Server
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage and maintain enterprise IT environments and databases
* Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams
* Project management experience.
* Strong Swedish and English language skills. (Mandatory) Location ONSITE - Solna, Stockholm
* Must be a Swedish citizen and hold a valid Drivers Lenience
* Must have an approved Security Clearance

title: Service Delivery Manager, Incident- och Problem Manager till Kronofogden IT
description:
Är du en erfaren Service Delivery Manager, Incident Manager och Problem Manager som vill bidra till stabil drift, hög kvalitet i incidenthantering och en modern IT‑leverans i en samhällsviktig myndighet? Då är detta rollen för dig!
   

  

 Vi söker nu två personer som tillsammans kommer att dela ansvaret för Incident Management och Problem Management, samtidigt som ni båda har ett tydligt ansvar som Service Delivery Manager.
   

  

 Hos oss bidrar du till ett välfungerande samhälle för allmänhet.
   

  

 Du får arbeta i en tekniskt komplex miljö, tillsammans med 230 kompetenta IT‑kollegor, och vara med och utveckla de tekniska förutsättningarna för våra 2 300 medarbetare. Kronofogden erbjuder ett modernt och hållbart arbetsliv där distansarbete är möjligt i den omfattning verksamheten beslutar.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Kronofogden befinner sig i en moderniseringsresa med digitalisering, automatisering och frekventa releaser. Inom IT skapar vi stabila, säkra och effektiva tjänster som möjliggör myndighetens samhällsuppdrag: att säkerställa finansieringen av den offentliga sektorn, skapa ett väl fungerande kreditsamhälle och motverka brottslighet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet Produktionsstöd, som ansvarar för driftleverans, styrning och operativt stöd. Teamet är en central funktion i myndigheten och säkerställer kvalitet, stabilitet och effektivitet i våra IT‑leveranser samt stödjer verksamheten med IT‑verktyg och IT-arbetsplatstjänster.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du att arbeta brett och ha ett kombinerat ansvar inom tre områden:
   

  

**Service Delivery Management**
* agera Service Delivery Manager gentemot våra leverantörer av IT‑tjänster
* säkerställa att servicenivåer och avtal (SLA/OLA) definieras, implementeras och följs upp
* säkerställa att tjänster levereras enligt avtal mot Kronofogden och mellan parter
* utveckla, implementera och förvalta effektiva processer för drift och förvaltning av IT‑tjänster
* samverka nära våra driftleverantörer och hantera operativa ärenden kopplat till driftleveransen
* självständigt driva och koordinera kortare uppdrag av varierande karaktär


**Incident Management**
* agera Incident Manager vid IT‑incidenter och säkerhetsincidenter
* aktivera incidentprocessen och etablera incidentkanal
* leda incidentmöten och koordinera interna och externa parter
* säkerställa tydlig och korrekt kommunikation under incidentens gång
* dokumentera incidentförlopp, beslut och åtgärder
* säkerställa strukturerad avslutning och återställning
* dela ansvaret för Incident Management med en kollega


**Problem Management**
* agera Problem Manager och driva rotorsaksanalyser (RCA)
* samordna tekniska och säkerhetsrelaterade analyser med leverantörer och interna funktioner
* identifiera bakomliggande orsaker, trender och återkommande problem
* säkerställa att åtgärdsplaner tas fram, följs upp och implementeras
* bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring av processer och arbetssätt
* dela ansvaret för Problem Management med en kollega


**Arbetssätt och teknik**
**Du Kommer Att Arbeta i En Modern Utvecklingsmiljö Med**
* frekventa releaser
* CI/CD‑flöden
* DevSecOps
* SAFe‑inspirerat arbetssätt
* outsourcade leveranser och komplexa integrationsmiljöer


 Rollen är placerad i Sundbyberg, med krav på minst två dagar per vecka på kontoret. Övriga dagar kan arbetet utföras på distans.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Som medarbetare på Kronofogden förväntas du leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.
   

  

 Du är analytisk, har gott omdöme och tar initiativ. Du arbetar engagerat och tar ansvar för att målen nås. Du skapar mervärde för myndigheten och har lätt för att bygga och upprätthålla goda kontakter och nätverk.
   

  

 Du bemöter andra med respekt och vänlighet, lyssnar aktivt och bidrar till en positiv och prestigelös arbetsmiljö. Du är strukturerad, kan samverka med andra för att nå mål, men arbetar även självständigt när det krävs.
   

  

 Du har mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt tydliggöra frågor inom din expertis gentemot både verksamhet och IT.
   

  

**Dina Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* flera års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som Service Delivery Manager eller motsvarande i större organisation (>1000 anställda)
* flera års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som Incident- och problem Manager
* erfarenhet av operativt arbete inom IT där delar av eller hela leveransen är outsourcad
* dokumenterad kunskap om ITIL och dess processer
* erfarenhet av IT‑drift, IT‑infrastruktur och plattformstjänster
* erfarenhet av Disaster Recovery och återställning av IT‑system
* erfarenhet av att leda större IT‑incidenter i komplexa miljöer
* erfarenhet av Problem Management och RCA‑metodik
* god förståelse för Incident, Problem och Change enligt ITIL 4
* erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt, gärna SAFe‑inspirerat
* erfarenhet av DevOps/DevSecOps och kontinuerlig leverans
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* god förmåga att dokumentera och kommunicera med både verksamhet och IT.


 Det är önskvärt att du har aktuell erfarenhet av:
   

  

* erfarenhet av budgetarbete eller ekonomisk uppföljning
* erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning i outsourcade miljöer
* erfarenhet av IT‑säkerhetsincidenter
* certifieringar såsom ITIL 4 Foundation eller högre, eller RCA‑metodik (t.ex. Kepner‑Tregoe)
* erfarenhet av processförvaltning eller dataskyddsrelaterade processer
* erfarenhet av Incident/Problem/Change i SAFe‑inspirerad organisation
* erfarenhet av personuppgiftsincidenter, informationssäkerhet eller dataskyddsprocesser
* erfarenhet av teknisk projektledning.


**Om oss**
 Kronofogden är en statlig myndighet med ett viktigt uppdrag. Vi jobbar nära människor i utsatta situationer. Vi hjälper den som inte har fått betalt och vägleder den som ska betala. Vi ger medborgare och företag information och god service, så att de kan fatta långsiktiga och hållbara beslut. Det kräver kunskap, handlings­kraft, omtanke och mod. Vi bidrar till ett väl fungerande samhälle för allmänhet och företag – ett samhälle där skulder och andra krav blir fastställda och indrivna på ett rättssäkert sätt.
   

  

 Hos oss kan du räkna med utmanande arbetsuppgifter som även är utvecklande för dig. När du går hem från en dag på jobbet kan du vara säker på att du har gjort något som verkligen räknas – både för andra och för dig.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader. Du blir anställd som IT-handläggare. Kronofogden erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete efter överenskommelse med arbetsgivaren.
   

  

 Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden. Det ställs också särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar. Vi ställer frågor vid intervju om tidigare eventuell brotts­lighet och brister i tidigare anställning. För slutkandidater ställs även dessa frågor till referenspersoner. Vi tar även in uppgifter om skulder registrerade hos Kronofogden, konkurs och närings­förbud. Framkomna uppgifter vägs in vid helhetsbedömningen av din lämplighet för den aktuella anställningen.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhets­prövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekry­teringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Lär känna oss bättre genom att besöka vår webbplats och följa oss på Linkedin.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-07!

title: Technology Management Consultant
description:
**Your role**
 As a BearingPoint consultant in our Technology team, you will be working on various projects delivering high-value insights to our clients. The team advises business leaders and offers services such as tech transformation, agile project management, change management, procurement, IT sourcing and process automation. Assignments span from high-level strategic advisory to client-side management and implementation of ERP and digital healthcare solutions. In your work, you will utilize your project management skills to drive change and bridge gaps between business and technology departments across various industries, especially within healthcare, retail, insurance and automotive sectors.
   

  

 Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs.
   

  

 Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, putting together new offerings, pitching to clients and other activities.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues**
 As an applicant, you understand high-level business processes and have experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or other business applications used to support various internal functions.
   

  

 You have 2-3 years of experience working on the above topics, and previous consulting experience is a clear advantage. We also expect you to hold a master's degree in Engineering, IT Management, Information Systems or other deemed relevant.
   

  

 You must enjoy working with others to achieve common goals, and as a colleague, you are reliable and show generosity to those around you. You also have a growth mindset and strong analytical skills.
   

  

 Additionally, to aid day-to-day business activities, some familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a must. As we manage projects and advise clients in both the private and public sectors, it´s a requirement that you have excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English (spoken and written).
   

  

**What We Offer**
 BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:
   

  

* Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
* An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
* A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
* Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
* An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.


**What now?**
 Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.
   

  

 During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.
   

  

 Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here.
   

  

- 

*As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.*

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**What will you do?**
 As a Senior Android Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel Android app. We are in the middle of migrating from Java to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose while continuously shipping product features to a global user base.
   

  

 You’ll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our Android platform.
   

  

**Areas Of Ownership**
* Drive the migration from Java to a modern Kotlin + Compose stack
* Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt
* Build and modernize Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
* Contribute to architecture decisions (MVVM/MVI, Coroutines, platform improvements)
* Collaborate closely with iOS, Web, Product, Design, and QA to ship the right solutions
* Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed
* Maintain and improve the overall health of the Android platform


**Requirements**
* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office
* 5+ years of experience building Android applications
* Strong knowledge of Kotlin (and solid Java understanding)
* Experience with modern Android architecture (Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, MVVM/MVI)
* Proven ability to work independently and ship high-quality code
* You care about the code you leave behind — you ship features without cutting corners
* You prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over clever complexity
* Experience migrating legacy Android codebases to modern stacks
* Experience with mobile CI/CD, testing, or DevOps practices is a plus
* It's a plus with experience with collaborating across platforms (iOS/Web)


**Why Rebtel?**
 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
   

  

 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
   

  

* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.


*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
 Rebtel is a company of about 70 people from 31 countries who share a common mission to empower diaspora communities around the world to stay connected to where they come from. From our office in central Stockholm, we help our user base of 1 million dual-culture people—predominantly from the global south—connect with and support their communities through affordable data-free international calling and mobile top-ups. With our app and online platform, we help dissolve the space between their worlds so they can live more connected lives.

title: Senior Sales Representative - Dell Solutions
description:
**Why Choose TD SYNNEX**
 As a Fortune 500 global technology distributor operating in over 100 countries, TD SYNNEX connects the world's leading technology vendors with thousands of partners and customers. With over 22,000 employees worldwide, we play a critical role in enabling businesses to adopt secure, scalable, and innovative IT solutions.
   

  

 In Sweden, we work closely with some of the most influential technology vendors and resellers in the market. Our strength lies in combining technical expertise, commercial insight, and strong partner relationships to deliver complex multi-vendor solutions that create long-term value.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of our Red Hat practice and offers the opportunity to work closely with customers in a highly visible, solution-oriented position.
   

  

**Build trusted partnerships. Grow meaningful business. Shape the future of technology solutions.**
**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior Sales Representative - Dell Solutions** 
 you will be part of our
 **Advanced Solutions** 
 business unit and take responsibility for developing selected partners within the Dell ecosystem.
   

  

 You will combine commercial ownership with relationship-building, business planning, and partner enablement. Rather than focusing only on short-term sales targets, this role is about creating sustainable growth through trust, collaboration, and a strong understanding of partner and customer needs.
   

  

**You Will Work Closely With**
* Assigned partners across Sweden
* Dell stakeholders
* Business Development Managers
* Solution Architects
* Marketing colleagues
* Internal sales and commercial teams


 Together, you will identify opportunities, create go-to-market plans, support bids and proposals, and help partners succeed with Dell solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Build and nurture strong, trusted relationships with assigned partners.
* Support partners with business planning, sales development, and growth initiatives.
* Work with Dell and internal teams to identify new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Business Development Manager on marketing plans, campaigns, and partner activities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architects to develop relevant and customer-focused solution proposals.
* Support quote creation, bid management, and commercial discussions.
* Help partners understand how Dell solutions can support their customers' business challenges.
* Participate in partner training, enablement sessions, events, and marketing activities.
* Recruit and develop new partners when relevant.
* Monitor market trends, partner performance, and profitability.
* Share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and contribute to a supportive team culture.


**What We're Looking For**
 We know that great candidates bring different strengths, backgrounds, and career journeys. You may be a strong fit even if your experience does not match every point below.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone With**
* Several years of experience in B2B sales, partner sales, account management, or solution-oriented sales.
* Experience from the IT, technology, infrastructure, hardware, software, or services industry.
* Experience working with Dell or similar vendors such as HP, Lenovo, Cisco, HPE, Microsoft, VMware, or comparable technology brands.
* Understanding of channel sales, partner ecosystems, or indirect sales models.
* Confidence in building relationships with partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce, Compass, or similar systems.
* Experience supporting or contributing to marketing campaigns, partner events, or sales activities.
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.
* A structured, collaborative, and proactive way of working.


 Experience in people management is helpful but not required. We also value experience mentoring others, sharing knowledge, leading projects, or helping colleagues succeed.
   

  

**Skills And Strengths That Matter In This Role**
 To succeed in this role, you do not need to be the loudest voice in the room. We value people who are thoughtful, commercially curious, and able to build trust over time.
   

  

**We Believe The Following Strengths Are Especially Important**
* Relationship-building and active listening
* Business planning and commercial understanding
* Collaboration across teams and functions
* Clear and confident communication
* Ability to understand partner and customer needs
* Structured follow-up and ownership
* Curiosity about technology and market trends
* A supportive approach to colleagues and partners
* Long-term thinking and sustainable growth mindset


**What We Offer**
 We want you to succeed both professionally and personally. In this role, you will have the opportunity to grow your career in a supportive, international technology environment.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A senior and visible role within the Dell ecosystem.
* The opportunity to influence partner growth across the Swedish market.
* Close collaboration with leading technology vendors, partners, and enterprise customers.
* A hybrid working model with flexibility.
* Competitive compensation package.
* Professional development and learning opportunities.
* Access to vendor knowledge, training, and internal expertise.
* A collaborative team culture where knowledge sharing is encouraged.
* A workplace that values diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership.
* Opportunities to mentor, influence, and contribute beyond your own sales portfolio.


 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
   

  

**What's In It For You?**
* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.


**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
 At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
*We Care, We Challenge, We Commit, We Collaborate*
 Join Scrive and be part of an international, fast-growing company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Collaborate with smart, caring, and driven colleagues across Europe as we shape the Scrive story. 🚀
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are currently looking for a
 **Technical Support Specialist** 
 to join our team and play a key role in
 **delivering** 
**fast, accurate, and caring service to our customers across Europe** 
 . This role is an exciting opportunity to act as the
 **first point of contact for our users, driving customer satisfaction, contributing to overall product success** 
 through cross-team collaboration.
   

  

 📍The role will be based in
 **Stockholm or Copenhagen (Hybrid)** 
 , and you will report to the
 **Head of Customer Support** 
 .
   

  

**As a Technical Support Specialist, You Will**
* Managing customer interactions: Triage and handle support tickets via our help center (Freshdesk) across email, and phone, providing clear, caring and timely communication.
* Investigate and escalate: Answer routine inquiries using existing resources, and accurately identify and escalate complex technical issues to second-line or technical teams with clear context.
* Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Experience, and other departments to resolve customer challenges and improve team workflows.
* Drive knowledge sharing: Show initiative in learning about new features, update internal knowledge base articles, and proactively flag recurring issues or bugs.


**What We’re Looking For**
 To succeed in this role, you should have:
   

  

* Experience in customer support, technical support, or a similar service-oriented role.
* Proven track record in delivering professional, empathic, and efficient customer service, balancing both functional questions and technical issues.
* Curiosity and patience – A genuine desire to support customers, adapt your communication based on the situation, and absorb product updates to continuously improve your service skills.
* Excellent time management – The ability to manage ticket queues, assign priorities based on urgency, and proactively flag blockers.
* Strong collaboration skills – A team-oriented mindset where you can effectively ask for support from team members or other departments when needed to move a ticket forward.
* Fluency in English and Swedish - Professional verbal and written proficiency in both English and Swedish is a requirement.


**🌟 Bonus Points If You Have**
* Tool proficiency – experience managing tickets and collaborating via tools like Freshdesk or Zendesk, Slack.
* Experience in fast-paced, high-growth working environments.
* Technical expertise related to eSign or Document Management related tools.


 In this role, we see that you demonstrate strong skills in
 **teamwork** 
 ,
 **continuous curiosity** 
 ,
 **adaptability** 
 , and
 **exceptional communication** 
 . These skills will play a key role in our assessment and discussions during the recruitment process.
   

  

***Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway!***
*Studies show that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Scrive, we value diverse perspectives and encourage anyone who is excited about this role to apply.*
 Founded in Sweden in 2010, Scrive is a leading European provider of e-signature and identity solutions, trusted by 13,000+ customers across a wide range of industries.
   

  

 Backed by Vitruvian Partners, we're scaling fast across the EU, with team members based across Europe and offices in Stockholm (HQ), Copenhagen, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Brno.
   

  

 We offer the opportunity to be part of a company where your ideas matter and your contribution helps build the future of digital trust. 💫

title: Anaplan Analyst
description:
Spaulding Ridge is an advisory and IT implementation firm. We help global organizations get financial clarity into the complex, daily sales, and operational decisions that impact profitable revenue generations, efficient operational performance, and reliable financial management.
   

  

 At Spaulding Ridge, we believe all business is personal. Core to our values is our relationships with our clients, our business partners, our team, and the global community. Our employees dedicate their time to helping our clients transform their business, from strategy through implementation and business transformation.
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **Anaplan Analyst** 
 to join our
 **Anaplan Delivery** 
 team!
   

  

 As an
 **Anaplan Analyst** 
 , you will gain hands-on experience supporting our clients within our Anaplan practice by solving problems and bringing innovative ideas to our international clients and teams.
   

  

**The role**
* Collaborate with team members to design and implement technology that aligns with client business objectives.
* Build mock Proof of Concepts within Anaplan for potential clients.
* Identify issues and structural problems and generate actionable recommendations using Anaplan implementation methodologies.
* Understand client business needs, goals, and objectives.


**You have**
* 1-2 years required of finance/FP&A, supply chain, and/or sales operations experience
* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Logistics, and/or Management Information Systems
* Strong skillset within Excel. Including an understanding of how to develop macros, and model large data sets utilizing Lookups and SumIf functions.
* Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite
* Sound understanding of Multi-Dimensional data architecture
* Previous Anaplan experience and certifications preferred but not required
* Experience with any business planning and modeling tools is preferred
* Fluency in English is needed for this role, as you would be part of international team.


 Please note, you need to be based in one of our office cities and have valid work / residency permit to be considered for this job opportunity.

 At Spaulding Ridge, we believe all business is personal. Each interaction with clients and colleagues is an opportunity to connect and contribute to mutual success.

title: Cybersecurity Testing Coordinator
description:
Deloitte is a global leader in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal and Consultative Services. With more than 470,000 employees in over 150 countries, we help our clients and our communities solve complex problems and achieve ambitious goals through domain and industry expertise, global reach and alliances with the largest tech providers. What defines Deloitte is our drive to make a meaningful difference. For us, this means long-term development and results for our clients and their companies, ideas and actions that also contribute to positive societal development. It is also about empowering our people and promoting their development.
   

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a
 **Cybersecurity Testing Coordinator** 
 to join our
 **Nordic Cybersecurity Assurance team** 
 . Do you possess knowledge of security testing practices, vulnerability management and risk management? Are you comfortable working independently, coordinating multiple engagements, and liaising with both technical and business stakeholders? Additionally, are you adept at clear and concise communication? If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to consider a career with us.
   

  

  





**Your team**




 You will be part of the Internal Deloitte Nordic Cybersecurity Assurance Team, not Client-facing function. You will be part of a fun & collaborative team that are truly passionate about our work in securing Deloitte & our clients. We are a team spread across the Nordic countries, Denmark, Norway, Sweden and Finland. Nordic Cybersecurity Assurance Team is part of bigger Nordic CISO’s function which covers areas such as Governance, Risk and Compliance, Security Architecture, Cybersecurity Assurance and Operations.
   

  

  





**Your assignments**




 As Cybersecurity Testing Coordinator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day coordination of the security testing program across the Nordics, and act as the central point of contact for Penetration Testing and Automated Application Testing of our internal systems and applications, ensuring a consistent, efficient, and compliant approach.
   

  

  





 Success in this role depends on a balanced ability to manage both the operational processes and the human elements of a testing program. You will:
   

  

  




* Coordinate and schedule Penetration Testing and Automated Application Testing engagements for internal systems, including scoping and liaising with internal teams and external testing providers
* Maintain the inventory of applications and systems in scope for mandatory security testing, including testing frequency and coverage status
* Track and follow up on remediation of findings with system owners, and manage the exception process where remediation cannot be completed within agreed timelines
* Own the budgeting for security testing activities, including forecasting, vendor cost tracking, and reporting on spend
* Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on testing coverage and remediation progress for leadership and governance bodies
* Continuously identify and implement improvements to the testing coordination process to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness


  

  

  

**Qualifications**

**Professional:**



* Degree in information/Cybersecurity or information technology
* You have minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a cybersecurity function, with a solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals
* High-level understanding of security testing tools and methodologies (e.g., vulnerability scanners, web application testing tools) and common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CVSS).
 **This role does not require you to perform penetration tests yourself**
* Understanding of AI and emerging technologies, and how they affect security risk and testing landscape
* Knowledge of risk management and risk analysis, including risk acceptance and exception handling
* Experience of external security accreditations, such as ISO 27001
* Knowledge of any programming language, SDLC processes, CI/CD pipelines and git
* Relevant certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, SSCP, CEH, or CRISC is an advantage — or intent to pursue one
* You have effective business communication skills to inform, partner, influence and manage key stakeholders across technical teams, system owners and testing vendors
* You write and speak English fluently
* You understand the importance of cultural background – especially differences between the Nordic countries.


**Personal:**
* You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, with an understanding of AI and an open mind toward adopting such tools in your work
* You are proactive and a team player
* You take ownership and responsibility
* You have a sense of humor which you retain even when it gets tensed
* You give attention to quality and detail


**Additional Information**

**We offer**




 At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We offer a range of on-the-job learning experiences, formal development programs at Deloitte University, and access to a personal coach to support you in identifying and utilizing your strengths. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.
   

  

  





 Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.
   

  

  





**How to apply**




 Your application should consist of a CV and you apply directly online.
   

  

  





 Please apply as soon as possible as we will review applications and interview candidates on an ongoing basis.
   

  

  





 At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.
   

  

  





*As a qualitative part of Deloitte's recruitment process, our final candidates undergo a background check, to increase awareness of our future employees, secure the working environment for our employees and meet regulatory requirements. The background check process is carried out in collaboration with To Find Out.* 

*https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/* 






 We are looking forward to your application!
   

  

  





  

  

  





**What impact will you make?**




 Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

**Vi erbjuder dig**

 \* Påverka för att snabbt skapa värde för våra kunder.
