**Om oss**
 GDM är ett företag i stark tillväxt som sedan starten 1992 har blivit ett välkänt varumärke inom IT-Sverige. Vi har vårt huvudkontor i Sundsvall och finns etablerade på flera orter. **Din ansökan**
 Vill du jobba i ett sammansvetsat team som sätter kunden i fokus? Vänta inte med din ansökan då urval sker löpande. Vid denna rekrytering kommer vi att genomföra bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidater.

 Placeringsort: Sundsvall

title: C++ Developer
description:
****Shape the future of music creation with us!****
 We're looking for a top C++ platform and plugin engine developer who will also help shape our build pipeline, CI/CD and other dev tools.
   

  

 At XLN Audio we help music creators bring their ideas to life with award-winning tools and plugins like Addictive Drums 2, Life, RC-20, and XO. Our products are used daily by music producers, songwriters, and creators of all genres worldwide.
   

  

 We’re passionate about high-performance tech and dev work applied to music creation, and we're looking for people who share that mindset.
   

  

****The Role****
 You'll have a key role in the XLN Audio dev team, combining hands-on C++ development with work on build systems and CI/CD. You need to be comfortable with both.
   

  

 As part of our highly competent team, you'll tackle challenging problems, and continually help improve our development processes. And you'll have a lot of responsibility.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop our platform in C++, including integrations with macOS, Windows, and all major DAW:s
* Optimize and fine-tune our build systems, improving the developer experience and shortening shipping times
* Improve our CI/CD systems, increasing build stability, speed, testing and the merge request workflow
* Implement platform features for better OS and DAW integration and improved audio engine and GUI performance
* Participate in product development, collaborating closely with our other teams


**About You**
 Above all you’re curious and eager to dig into tricky issues, and you have a high sense of responsibility.
   

  

 You like challenges, diving into unfamiliar systems and learning as you go. You enjoy working in a supportive environment where there are no stupid questions.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2-5 years experience of C++ work in production environments
* Hands-on experience with CMake and familiarity with the Conan package manager
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, or similar
* Confidence working with the command line
* Strong proficiency in Git
* Proficiency with Python
* Familiarity with Lua, audio plugin development or music production is a bonus


****What we offer****
 We’re a curious team of 40 colleagues who all love making plugins and music creation tools. If you’re a team player and eager to learn new stuff you'll feel right at home.
   

  

 At XLN you get a competitive benefits package, including insurance, pension, paid vacation, wellness support, preventive health insurance, and continuous learning opportunities. We work primarily on-site at our office in Stockholm, Sweden, with some possibilities of remote work.
   

  

 It's a big plus if you have an active interest in music-making in some form, like playing instruments, DJ:ing or beat-making.
   

  

 Our office has two complete music studios plus a jam room, perfect for labbing new product concepts or spontaneous playing with colleagues. And we have a ping pong table, of course.

title: Program Manager Sweden
description:
**Missions Program Manager / Senior Missions Program Manager**
* Location: Sweden or Espoo
* Department: Missions Programs
* Reports to: Program Director
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Remote / Hybrid / Office
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) - must be able to attain Swedish Security Clearance


**Why This Role Matters**
 As a mission program manager , you’ll deliver a complex Satellite Mission program end-to-end, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.
   

  

 You will ensure the full lifecycle of customer missions—from contract execution through delivery—acting as the central orchestrator across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams. Your role is to ensure programs deliver against commitments while building strong, trusted customer relationships.
   

  

 This role directly contributes to ICEYE’s ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
   

  

 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
   

  

 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
   

  

 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
   

  

**Expected outcomes**
* Deliver assigned Satellite Mission programs on time, within budget, and to agreed performance standards
* Build and maintain trusted, long-term customer relationships, acting as the primary interface throughout program execution and supporting Customer Success Management activities
* Establish and drive clear program plans (scope, milestones, resources, financials) aligned with internal and customer objectives
* Identify, manage, and resolve risks, dependencies, and escalations to ensure uninterrupted program delivery
* Orchestrate cross-functional execution across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams
* Support the implementation of scalable program management practices that improve delivery reliability and efficiency across Missions
* Establish effective reporting structure and communication channels and mechanisms to ensure timely and accurate information flow among program team members, stakeholders, and senior leadership


**What We’re Looking For**
**Must have competences:**
* Proven experience (5–10 years) managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs involving advanced technology systems (e.g., space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT, or similar)
* Strong customer-facing experience, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex requirements
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams
* Expertise in program planning, execution, and governance (scope, schedule, budget, risk management)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make decisions under uncertainty
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences
* Fluent Swedish (native level) and ability to obtain security clearance


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience working on satellite or similarly complex system programs
* Experience with governmental or defense customers
* Knowledge of hardware, software, or embedded systems development
* Experience in product development environments
* Master’s degree in business, engineering, or a relevant field
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification


**Application Process**
* Initial screening call with Talent Attraction
* Hiring Manager interview
* Case Study & Interview
* Final interview
* References


**Working at ICEYE**
 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
   

  

**How We Work (Our Values)**
* Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.
   

  

 We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.
   

  

 Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at
 **iceye.com**

description:
Hos TV4 möts teknik, innovation, nyhetsjournalistik, sport och underhållning.
   

  

 Varje vecka använder omkring åtta miljoner människor TV4 Play och MTV Katsomo. Bakom våra produkter finns stora mängder data som hjälper oss förstå våra användare, utveckla våra tjänster och fatta bättre beslut.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en
 **Product Manager Data** 
 som vill ta en central roll i att forma hur vi arbetar med data och hur den skapar värde för våra produkter, användare och verksamhet.
   

  

**Varför den här rollen är viktig**
 Data är en central del av TV4 produktutveckling och används av många delar av organisationen. Vårt Datateam arbetar med allt från dataplattform och tillgängliggörande av data till analys och machine learning.
   

  

 Vi befinner oss samtidigt i en större förändring där TV4 och MTV bygger en gemensam nordisk produkt och teknikorganisation med mer självständiga produktteam. För Data innebär det både teknisk utveckling och ett behov av att bli ännu bättre på att förstå vilka problem som är viktigast att lösa och var data kan skapa störst värde.
   

  

 Som Product Manager får du en central roll i den utvecklingen. Tillsammans med Engineering Manager och teamet formar du riktning och prioriteringar för Data området och skapar förutsättningar för att omsätta behov från olika delar av organisationen till tydliga produktinitiativ.
   

  

**Varför du vill kliva ombord**
 Du tycker om att arbeta där produkt, teknik och affär möts och vill förstå problemen bakom önskemålen innan du börjar definiera lösningen.
   

  

 Du trivs med komplexitet och med att väga olika behov mot varandra. Du kan skapa riktning även när alla svar ännu inte finns och är bekväm med att prioritera det som skapar mest värde framför det som bara skapar mest aktivitet.
   

  

 Du behöver förstå teknik och data tillräckligt väl för att kunna föra kvalificerade diskussioner med engineers och andra specialister, men ditt fokus ligger på varför vi bygger något, för vem och vilken effekt det ska skapa.
   

  

**Om teamet**
 Data är ett nordiskt område som arbetar för både TV4 i Sverige och MTV i Finland. Teamet består av Data Engineers och Data Scientists och arbetar nära många olika delar av vår produkt och teknikorganisation.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära teamets Engineering Manager. Tillsammans skapar ni förutsättningar för teamets utveckling, med olika tyngdpunkter. Som Product Manager har du särskilt fokus på produktriktning, prioritering, behov och värdeskapande.
   

  

 Du blir också en del av TV4 Product Competence team och arbetar tillsammans med andra Product Managers för att utveckla hur vi bedriver produktarbete över hela organisationen.
   

  

**Vad du kommer att göra**
* Sätta och kommunicera riktningen för Data området tillsammans med Engineering Manager och teamet
* Utveckla och driva roadmap utifrån behov, affärsvärde och tekniska förutsättningar
* Identifiera var data kan skapa störst värde för våra produkter, användare och verksamhet
* Förstå och väga samman behov från olika produktområden och delar av organisationen
* Skapa tydlighet kring vad vi prioriterar, varför vi gör det och vilken effekt vi vill uppnå
* Arbeta nära Data Engineers och Data Scientists för att omsätta behov och möjligheter till fungerande lösningar
* Utveckla hur Data området samarbetar med och skapar värde för resten av organisationen
* Följa upp resultat och använda nya insikter för att utveckla riktning och prioriteringar


**Om dig**
 Du är en erfaren Product Manager som är van att arbeta i tekniskt komplexa produktmiljöer. Du kan förstå både användarens, verksamhetens och teknikens perspektiv och använda dem för att skapa riktning och göra tydliga prioriteringar.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara den främsta dataexperten i rummet, men du har tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att kunna arbeta trovärdigt med engineers och specialister inom data. Du är nyfiken på hur tekniken fungerar och kan sätta dig in i komplexa frågor utan att själv behöva äga den tekniska lösningen.
   

  

 Du är bekväm med att arbeta i en miljö där organisation, arbetssätt och teknik fortfarande utvecklas. Du tar initiativ, kommunicerar tydligt och kan skapa framdrift även när vägen framåt inte är helt definierad.
   

  

 Vi tror att du:
   

  

* Har flerårig erfarenhet som Product Manager i tekniskt komplexa produktmiljöer
* Har erfarenhet av att sätta produktriktning
* Har god teknisk förståelse och kan arbeta med engineeringteam
* Förstår hur data kan användas för att skapa produktvärde och bättre beslut
* Är van att arbeta med flera stakeholders och kan skapa tydlighet mellan olika perspektiv
* Kan röra dig mellan strategiska frågor och konkreta produktbeslut
* Trivs i tvärfunktionella team med stort eget ansvar


 Det är ett extra plus om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Dataplattformar eller datadrivna produkter
* Data engineering, analytics eller machine learning
* Streaming, media eller andra digitala konsumentprodukter
* Produktorganisationer i förändring


**Vad TV4 erbjuder dig**
* Kort väg från idé till beslut. Vi är en senior techorganisation med hög autonomi för team och individ.
* En kultur som värdesätter hållbara lösningar och långsiktigt ansvar.
* Möjlighet att vara med och forma både Data området och hur vi arbetar med produktutveckling på TV4.
* Kontor i TV4 huset nära Gärdets tunnelbana med gym, restaurang och andra gemensamma ytor.
* Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar och friskvårdsbidrag.
* Valfri telefon, MacBook Pro samt rabatter via Benify.


**Praktisk information**
 TV4 är office first och vi arbetar normalt från kontoret fyra dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

 Facklig tillhörighet: Unionen. Kontakta unionen@tv4.se för frågor.
   

  

 Bakgrundskontroll ingår i processen.
   

  

**Ansökan och process**
 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och intervjuer, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Finance Transformation Management Consultant
description:
*Our Finance & Risk Team is expanding, and we are looking for dynamic Consultants with an entrepreneurial drive to join our team.* 




  





**The role** 




  





 In your work, you will combine your financial and technical knowledge to bridge gaps between business and technology departments at large corporations across various industries. Our Finance & Risk team collaborates closely with our clients by establishing strategic roadmaps for financial operations. Our project deliveries for CFO organizations include solutions for Financial Planning, financial consolidation, statutory reporting, ESG reporting. Our team works hands-on with the automation and transformation of these new processes for our clients. We manage end-to-end projects, covering implementations, development, and change management.
 



  





 Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, putting together new offerings, pitching to clients and other activities. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.
 



  





 As a BearingPoint consultant, you will also work in close collaboration with our Technology and Data & Analytics teams on projects that span from high-level strategic advisory to client-side management of systems implementation.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues** 




  





 You have a general understanding of and are interested in learning more about end-to-end finance processes such as Financial Accounting, Controlling, System Administration, or Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A). You also have some experience working with any Enterprise Resource Planning system handling financial data.
 



  





 You hold a master's degree or will graduate with a master’s degree in industrial engineering and management, information systems, IT, Business, Finance, or other education that is deemed relevant.
 



  





 We are a committed team with great ambitions for growth. Therefore, we are looking for people with an entrepreneurial drive and a genuine interest in developing finance processes with modern technologies, automation, and AI. Most important is who you are as a person and your interest in the topics above. If the role description intrigues you, please send us your application!
 



  





**Additionally** 
 , here are some things that will set you apart as a candidate, make sure to mention some if applicable. We want people with diverse sets of skills, so no need to cover all below.
 


* Examples from your work history of a project or initiative where your involvement was central to the overall value created.
* Prior experience as a Business/Management Consultant.
* Prior experience as a Controller or with accounting.
* Hands-on experience working with ERP/EPM solutions or other systems handling financial data.
* Work experience in a technical field (such as development, testing, deployment) and/or understanding of databases and integrations.



 Applicants must have excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English (spoken and written). Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is also necessary to aid day-to-day business activities.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  





 We offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:
 



  




* Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
* An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
* A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, 5000 SEK wellness grant, expanded parental benefits, and more.
* Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
* An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.



  





**What now?** 




  





 Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, but please include a short pitch. Interviews will be held continuously.
 



  





 During the interview process, you'll meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.
 



  





 Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article on what we do here.
 



  





*As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.*

title: Teknisk testare till Financial Crime Prevention
description:
Vill du bidra till utvecklingen av system som hjälper Handelsbanken att förebygga finansiell brottslighet? Vi söker nu en teknisk testare, eller en utvecklare som vill utvecklas inom test och kvalitetssäkring, till FAIR, vårt agila utvecklingståg inom Financial Crime Prevention.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av ett utvecklingsteam bestående av utvecklare, Team Coach och Product Owner. Teamet arbetar nära verksamheten och andra utvecklingsteam för att utveckla och förvalta systemstöd som används i arbetet med att motverka penningtvätt, finansiering av terrorism och efterlevnad av internationella sanktioner.
   

  

 Financial Crime Prevention är ett högt prioriterat område inom Handelsbanken med många pågående och kommande utvecklingsinitiativ. FAIR-tåget befinner sig just nu i en spännande utvecklingsfas med flera systemförflyttningar och ett större strategiskt program som kommer att påverka hur området utvecklas under de kommande åren.
   

  

 Vi arbetar enligt agila principer och samarbetar nära verksamheten genom hela utvecklingsprocessen. Arbetet präglas av kunskapsdelning, gemensamt ansvarstagande och ett nära samarbete mellan team, arkitekter och verksamhetsspecialister för att skapa effektiva och hållbara lösningar.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som teknisk testare ansvarar du för verifiering och kvalitetssäkring av de lösningar som utvecklas inom teamet. Du arbetar nära utvecklare och verksamhet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från krav och design till implementation och produktionssättning.
   

  

 Rollen innebär både operativt testarbete och utveckling av teamets arbetssätt inom kvalitetssäkring. Du bidrar med teststrategier, planering och genomförande av tester samtidigt som du säkerställer att lösningarna uppfyller funktionella och tekniska krav.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:
   

  

* Planera, genomföra och dokumentera tester
* Ta fram testplaner och testfall
* Genomföra manuella och automatiserade tester
* Utföra regressionstester och verifiering av systemleveranser
* Bidra till utvecklingen av teamets teststrategier och testautomatisering
* Delta i analys av krav, design och lösningsförslag ur ett kvalitetsperspektiv
* Samarbeta med andra team och intressenter för att säkerställa hög kvalitet genom hela leveranskedjan


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har en teknisk bakgrund, antingen som utvecklare eller teknisk testare, och som har ett starkt intresse för kvalitetssäkring och test.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:**
* Testarbete i systemutvecklingsprojekt
* Att ta fram testplaner och testfall
* Manuella och automatiserade tester
* SQL och verifiering mot databaser
* Moderna testverktyg
* Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Det är ett plus om du även har erfarenhet av:**
* Testautomatisering
* Testdriven utveckling (TDD)
* Programmering i Java eller JavaScript
* ETL-processer och datadrivna flöden
* Agila arbetssätt
* Jira, Zephyr eller Confluence


 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett analytiskt arbetssätt och trivs med att sätta dig in i komplexa frågeställningar. Du kan identifiera samband, utvärdera olika perspektiv och omsätta dina insikter till välgrundade slutsatser.
   

  

 Du samarbetar gärna med andra och bidrar aktivt till kunskapsutbyte inom teamet. Genom att ta tillvara olika perspektiv och kompetenser bidrar du till att skapa lösningar med hög kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du har ett driv att utveckla och förbättra arbetssätt, testmetoder och automatisering. Du arbetar strukturerat, dokumenterar ditt arbete på ett tydligt sätt och säkerställer att kvalitet genomsyrar hela utvecklingsprocessen.
   

  

 Rollen innebär att du ibland behöver utmana etablerade arbetssätt och lyfta förbättringsområden. Därför ser vi att du är trygg i din kompetens, kan stå för dina bedömningar och konstruktivt bidra till förändring när det behövs.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter**
**Rekryterande chef:** 
 Daniel Kallur, daniel.kallur@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Talent Acquisition Partner:** 
 Julia Beard, julia.beard@handelsbanken.se
 **Facklig representant Finansförbundet:** 
 Michael Löfström, michael.lofstrom@handelsbanken.se
   

  

**Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen:** 
 Cecilia Zielfelt, cecilia.zielfelt@handelsbanken.se

title: HIL Engineer – Test Infrastructure & Verification
description:

**Industry:** Automotive / Commercial Vehicles
  
**Employment:** Full-time
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an experienced HIL Engineer to join an advanced automotive engineering team in Gothenburg.
  
You will work with HIL rigs, test infrastructure, system verification and test automation, supporting the development and verification of next-generation vehicle systems.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Maintain, configure and improve HIL rigs and test environments.
  
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues in HIL setups.
  
Support system and end-to-end verification activities.
  
Develop and improve automated test solutions.
  
Configure and integrate ECUs, communication interfaces and simulation systems.
  
Coordinate HIL infrastructure activities with verification and development teams.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement of test environments and processes.
  
  

Your Background
  
We are looking for experience in HIL, automotive testing, verification or test infrastructure.
  
  

**Relevant experience includes:**  

HIL rig development and maintenance
  
Test automation and scripting
  
ECU and embedded systems testing
  
System verification and validation
  
Hardware/software troubleshooting
  
Automotive communication networks
  
  

Experience with CANoe/CANalyzer, dSPACE, MATLAB/Simulink, Python, CAN/CAN FD, Automotive Ethernet or CI/CD is a strong advantage.
  
Experience from infotainment, HMI, driver interaction or connected vehicles is also beneficial.

Good English communication skills.
  
Swedish is an advantage.
  
  

Interested?
  
If you have a strong HIL background and want to work with advanced vehicle technology, we would like to hear from you.

title: Junior R&D ingenjör
description:
Integration Diagnostics and its core products, Penguin RFA and Osseo100 measures dental implant stability to enable clinicians to decide when to load an implant. The technique has been developed in close cooperation with clinicians and experts in the field of dental implantology.
  
Resonance Frequency Analysis (RFA) and the measurement unit Implant Stability Quotient (ISQ) were introduced into the dental implant industry in 2001 and are now established methods of measuring implant stability and osseointegration.
  
In 2015, in response to the dental community’s need for an accessible ISQ measuring system, Integration Diagnostics Sweden AB (IDSAB) was founded. Sales have developed rapidly with clients today in + 70 countries globally.
  
In 2018, Integration Diagnostics became part of the Japanese company Nakanishi Inc. Nakanishi Inc., is a world-leading company of professional dental instruments with the world’s top-share brand “NSK”. All its products are developed and manufactured in Japan and distributed to 135 countries around the globe. The NSK Group has 14 subsidiaries worldwide and has established a strong global sales network.
  
We are currently looking for a,
  
Junior R&D Engineer – Medtech
  
As a Junior R&D Engineer, you will be part of a small and agile R&D team, working closely with the R&D Director, who is also the founder of the company. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the entire product lifecycle, from concept development and testing to technical documentation and production support.
  
You will play an active role in maintaining and improving existing products while supporting the development of future innovations within IDSAB's medical device portfolio.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

Contribute to the maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of commercially available products.
  
Support the development and refinement of R&D methodologies, development processes, verification activities, and testing procedures in collaboration with the R&D team.
  
Manage existing technical documentation and prepare new technical documentation when required.
  
Work cross-functionally with colleagues in R&D, Quality Assurance, Production, and Product Management.
  
  

In this position, your daily work has a wide scope and is conducted in a dynamic, innovative international working environment.
  
  

Qualifications
  
* Master of Science in Engineering (M.Sc.) or Bachelor of Science in Engineering (B.Sc.) in Electronics, Engineering Physics, Medical Engineering, or a related field.
* Good knowledge about medical device development
* Fluent in Swedish and English


Preferred Experience
  
  

**The following experience is considered an advantage:**  

Hands-on experience from experimental work, laboratory environments, or workshop activities.
  
Practical experience gained through master's thesis projects, personal side projects, student competitions, or involvement in student organizations focused on engineering, electronics, robotics, or product development.
  
Experience in prototyping, CAD, testing, troubleshooting, or building technical systems.
  
Previous experience within the medical device industry is highly valued.
  
  

To succeed in this role, you are a user- and patient centric person with a strong drive to provide innovative products. You have a broad technical interest, and you can navigate in both hardware and software development.
  
  

You will be part of an exciting and challenging journey shaping the company’s future and taking the business to new heights. In this role you will have a great opportunity to make an impact and improve the products and solutions we supply to the market, and you will have a big variation in activities.
  
  

Application
  
To apply, please send your CV to career@idsab.com
  
  

By submitting your application, you also consent to us storing your personal data, including CV & cover letter. You can revoke the consent whenever you want.

title: Quantum Measurement Engineer
description:
ConScience AB is a dynamic and innovative company advancing superconducting quantum devices and technologies. We are looking for a Quantum Measurement Engineer to join our growing team and play a key role in the characterization and continued development of our superconducting quantum devices.
  
  

**About the Role:**  

As a Quantum Measurement Engineer at ConScience, you will take an active, hands-on role in the experimental characterization of superconducting quantum devices. You will set up and conduct measurements, analyze experimental data, and translate results into insights about device performance. A key part of the role is independently planning, performing, and troubleshooting experiments while developing reliable and reproducible measurement and analysis workflows. At the same time, you will work closely with our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers to deliver high-quality results for R&D and commercial projects.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Set up, conduct, troubleshoot, analyze, and interpret experimental measurements of superconducting quantum devices
* Characterize and calibrate quantum devices and circuits and evaluate key device-performance parameters
* Develop and improve measurement protocols and experimental methods for device characterization
* Develop scientific software, measurement, and data-analysis workflows
* Analyze experimental data, identify trends and sources of error
* Prepare and handle samples, including mounting and basic hardware assembly
* Contribute to reliable and reproducible measurement procedures and laboratory workflows
* Document experimental methods, results, and conclusions clearly
* Collaborate closely with the team and communicate technical results to colleagues, collaborators, and clients


**What We’re Looking For:**  

We are looking for someone who enjoys experimental problem-solving and is comfortable moving between hands-on laboratory work, data analysis, and scientific programming.
  
  

**Required qualifications:**  

* MSc in physics, applied physics, electrical engineering, computer science, quantum engineering, nanotechnology, or another relevant STEM field
* Hands-on experience independently setting up, conducting, troubleshooting, and interpreting experimental measurements
* Experience with scientific programming and data analysis
* Comfortable with practical laboratory work, including sample handling, mounting, and basic hardware assembly
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary team
* Good written and spoken English


**Meritorious Qualifications:**  

You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
  
* Superconducting qubits, Josephson-junction devices, or other cryogenic quantum devices
* Qubit characterization and calibration
* Two-qubit gate calibration and characterization
* Multi-qubit devices or larger superconducting quantum circuits and architectures
* Dilution refrigerators and cryogenic measurement setups
* RF/microwave measurements and instrumentation
* Automated experimental measurement and data-analysis workflows
* Design of superconducting qubits or other superconducting circuits
* RF/microwave device packaging and integration
* Noise, decoherence, and crosstalk in superconducting quantum devices


Why Join Us?
  
At ConScience AB, you will be part of an ambitious, passionate, and diverse team advancing superconducting quantum technology. We offer a flexible, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating environment where ideas, initiative, and practical problem-solving are valued, and where you will have with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across both quantum science and industry.
  
Ready to help characterize the next generation of quantum devices?
  
How to Apply
  
  

**Please submit:**  

1. Your CV
  
2. A short motivation letter (maximum two A4 pages) describing your interest in the
  
position and your motivation for joining ConScience
  
3. Contact details for at least two references
  
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
  
Öppen för alla
  
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Vill du bli en del av vårt konsultgäng i Göteborg?
description:

Är du redo för nästa steg i karriären och söker en arbetsgivare som bryr sig om både din utveckling och hur du faktiskt har det på jobbet?

title: Software Verification Engineers and Senior Test Leads
description:
### **Job description**


Vill du arbeta med verifiering och validering av avancerad mjukvara i säkerhetskritiska system? Vi söker nu både erfarna **Software Verification Engineers** och **Senior Software Test Leads** till tekniskt komplexa uppdrag i Huskvarna.


Beroende på din erfarenhet kan du arbeta operativt med kravbaserad mjukvaruverifiering och testautomatisering, eller ta en ledande roll med ansvar för planering, koordinering och uppföljning av verifieringsarbetet.


**Om rollen**


Du kommer att arbeta i en säkerhetskritisk utvecklingsmiljö där verifiering, spårbarhet och dokumentation är centrala delar av arbetet. Du samarbetar nära utvecklare, testingenjörer, kravspecialister, projektledning och andra tekniska funktioner.


**Som Software Verification Engineer kan du bland annat arbeta med att:**
* Utveckla, underhålla och exekvera testfall
* Verifiera mjukvarukrav och tillhörande dokumentation
* Genomföra test- och valideringsaktiviteter
* Säkerställa spårbarhet mellan krav, testfall och testresultat
* Dokumentera testresultat och sammanställa tekniska rapporter
* Identifiera och bidra till att hantera mjukvarurelaterade risker
* Utveckla automatiserade testlösningar
* Samarbeta med utvecklingsteam för att analysera avvikelser och förbättra mjukvarans kvalitet

För den här inriktningen är erfarenhet av mjukvaruverifiering, testfallsutveckling samt programmering i Python och C särskilt relevant.


**Som Senior Software Test Lead kan du även ansvara för att:**
* Leda och koordinera mjukvarutestning
* Planera, prioritera och följa upp testaktiviteter
* Säkerställa att verifiering och validering genomförs enligt projekt- och certifieringskrav
* Koordinera testingenjörer och bidra till att bygga upp effektiva arbetssätt
* Granska kravspecifikationer med fokus på testbarhet och testtäckning
* Analysera testresultat och stödja rotorsaksanalyser
* Hantera avvikelser, risker och kvalitetsindikatorer
* Rapportera status och risker till projektledning och andra intressenter
* Delta i interna och externa revisioner samt certifieringsaktiviteter
* Driva utvecklingen av automatiserade testlösningar och testmiljöer

Den ledande inriktningen kräver erfarenhet av att leda team eller koordinera verifierings- och testaktiviteter i komplexa utvecklingsprojekt.


### **Basic qualifications**


**Vi söker dig som har**


* Flera års erfarenhet av mjukvarutestning, verifiering eller validering
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla och genomföra strukturerade testfall
* God förståelse för mjukvaruutvecklingsprocesser och testmetodik
* Förmåga att analysera krav och bedöma deras testbarhet
* Erfarenhet av testautomatisering och moderna testverktyg
* God problemlösningsförmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt
* Förmåga att dokumentera och kommunicera tekniska resultat
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

För rollen som Software Verification Engineer behöver du även ha erfarenhet av programmering i **Python och C**.
För rollen som Senior Software Test Lead behöver du ha erfarenhet av att leda eller koordinera test- och verifieringsarbete.


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**


* Säkerhetskritiska system
* Flyg-, försvars-, fordons- eller medicinteknisk industri
* Regulatoriska och formella utvecklingsmiljöer
* DO-178C, ARP4754A eller liknande standarder
* Inbyggda system, realtidssystem eller avionik
* Kravhantering och spårbarhet
* IBM DOORS eller liknande kravhanteringsverktyg
* Testautomatisering och utveckling av testmiljöer
* Certifieringsarbete och revisioner
* ISTQB-certifiering eller motsvarande
### **Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience**


**Vem är du?**


Du är strukturerad, analytisk och noggrann, med en god förståelse för verifieringens betydelse i tekniskt komplexa och säkerhetskritiska system. Du trivs med att arbeta metodiskt och kan växla mellan teknisk detaljnivå och ett bredare systemperspektiv.


Du kommunicerar tydligt och samarbetar väl med olika kompetenser. Om du söker den ledande inriktningen har du dessutom förmåga att skapa struktur, engagemang och framdrift i ett tvärfunktionellt team.


### **We offer**


På Sigma Industry Evolution arbetar du tillsammans med juniora och erfarna kollegor med ett aktivt erfarenhetsutbyte med uppdrag för de främsta utvecklingsintensiva företagen. Våra konsultuppdrag anpassas alltid i möjligaste mån, för att nivån ska bli så utvecklande och stimulerande som möjligt.


Vår företagskultur präglas av entreprenörskap och korta beslutsvägar. Gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga element som vi anser skapar trivsel.


*Sigma Industry Evolution AB är ett teknikkonsultföretag inom produkt- och produktionsutveckling med fokus på Mekatronik , Elektronik, Inbyggda system och AI-utveckling.*

*Kombinationen av lång branscherfarenhet, stort engagemang, interna och externa uppdrag samt ett tätt samarbete mellan Sigmas olika verksamheter i regionen skapar ett unikt branschöverskridande växthus för ingenjörer. Med mångfald, delaktighet och entreprenörskap stärker och utvecklar vi vår verksamhet och våra medarbetare.*

title: Thesis Work – Motion control limited mechanical dimensioning
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Department/Local Unit Lead **Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.**

**At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.**


At ABB, you can be sure you are helping to create a better world. Why not take the chance to do this while working in one of the most fascinating technology areas in modern industry – Robotics!


ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry.


Now we are offering an exciting master thesis within Mechanical Analysis R&D.


Within ABB Robotics R&D, the Mechanical Analysis team configures Manipulators by choosing gears, motors, kinematics and arms and analyzing them with FEM. To do even better we constantly evolve our methods to produce faster, more accurate and better-quality products. All the parts of the manipulator must be dimensioned against the loads occurring during motion and to make the best optimized product we must have control over the input for these calculations. In this project you get the chance to do FEM dimensioning in different ways in our manipulators and get the chance to develop the next step.


The goal of this thesis is to help develop and prove new concepts of mechanical dimensioning. With the help of both mechanical analysis team and motion control team we dive deeper into ways to make predictive maintenance easier. The new features might even arrive in next generation of manipulators to provide better and more robust industry robots.


Details:

* January-June 2027
* 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng(hp)
* One student
* Most time on site in Västerås


Your responsibilities

* Investigate different partly pre-defined concepts of dimensioning
* Collaborate with both mechanics and motion team.
* Set up and perform load calculations on manipulators with rigid body simulations
* Verify and compare ways of dimensioning
* Evaluate arms and machine elements with both FEM and analytical formulas
* Living ABB’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


Your background

* Engineering student in Mechanical engineering, Engineering Physics, Engineering Mechanics, Applied and Computational Mathematics or similar profile.
* Basic knowledge of mechanics, Finite element method and machine elements
* Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team.


More about us

**Bring your very own sense of pride and purpose as you help us drive forward the Fourth Industrial Revolution – creating a sustainable future for our planet, and your career. Join ABB and harness the power of our diverse global network, as you collaborate with and learn from our world-class teams. Above all, challenge yourself every day. Let’s write the future, together.**

**More information:** Supervisor Andréas Göransson, +46724612332, will answer your questions. Recruiting Manger Linda Hjärne, + 46724614641, Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Eric Ramsel +46730822030. Positions are filled continuously and start date is January. Apply with your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter in English


Welcome to apply!


A Future Opportunity  

Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.


We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

title: Supplier Development Engineer - Sheet Metal & Plastics
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------


Key responsibilities will include building strong relationship with our suppliers that creates benefits for both parties. You will be involved in evaluation and selection of suppliers, and the driver of APQP/PPAP activities for selected projects working close to our Technology organization. You will also be a part of creation and execution of Purchasing strategies, and with that comes encouraging our suppliers for development and increase innovation.

  

You will in your role also educate and mentor activities from cost to quality requirements. To steer sustainability supply chain management programs and drive productivity improvement program such as VPS/Lean and guide continuous improvement actions will also be in your responsibility.

**Your future team**

  

Supplier Development Europe team is a diverse group of colleagues respecting Volvo group values (change, customer success, passion, trust, and performance) that creates a high performing culture. We are an effective and efficient one team organization with a lot of experience in Quality management and Lean manufacturing. We are building tailored Supplier development programs with our suppliers to boost Quality, Sustainability, Capacity, Cost performance and aligning suppliers’ strategies with our purchasing goals and expectations.

**Who are you?**
----------------


We are looking for a colleague, who has an agile character, is eager to learn and improve. You have a positive and entrepreneurial mindset and always looking for the next target to reach. You are experienced in driving project management in an effective way and have knowledge about product development.

  

Your communicational capability makes it easy for you to make contact with both internal and external stakeholders, you have the ability to manage and influence others, as well as you are structured and focused on the execution. You are analytic and have a sustainable mindset. We think that you are comfortable in meeting and working cross-functional and are able to work within remote management, and also to have parallel activities going on.

 **KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE we are looking for**

  

University degree in engineering or similar


Experience from quality/production area


Knowledge in supply chain management and Lean manufacturing


Educational or practical experience within sheet metal / plastics processes preferable


Good communication skills in English + local language

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------


For more information:


Christian Magnusson, Head of Supplier Development CAB/Sheet Metal & Plastics/Paint/Electrics & Electronics/Software Europe: +46 16 541 45 10.  

Location: flexible Eskilstuna, Braås, Arvika, Hallsberg, Konz, Wroclav, Belley.


Last application day is the 4th of October.


As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

  

Part of Volvo Group, **Volvo Construction Equipment** is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

Now we’re looking for an **Embedded test & verification engineer** to join our team and help us make great systems even better.

**Who we’re looking for:**


What matters most to us is your interest in **understanding embedded systems, troubleshooting complex problems, and finding root causes – not always just running test cases**.


 We’re looking for embedded engineers in Test & Verification at different experience levels – from curious, hands-on engineers early in their career to more senior profiles with solid experience in testing and troubleshooting embedded systems.


You enjoy working close to hardware, software and want to understand how things *really* work, spotting issues early, and making products more reliable, stable, and safe.

 **If you check some of the boxes below, we look forward to your application:**

* You work close to **hardware and software** and enjoy hands-on debugging
* You are interested in or have experience with **HIL, SIL, VIL, MIL**, or similar test environments
* You are comfortable analyzing logs, signals, and system behavior
* You like guiding teams toward where a fault is likely located

 ***Experience we value:***

* Testing and verification of embedded software and systems
* System-level testing where hardware and software meet (e.g. HIL, test rigs)
* Debugging and root-cause analysis (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, log analysis)
* Communication protocols such as **CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART**
* Reading and understanding **C/C++**
* **Python or scripting** for test automation or tooling

 ***Bonus (not required):***

* Automotive, safety-critical, or regulated environments
* **CI/CD, Git, Linux**
* Requirement handling and traceability
* Test automation and continuous integration
* **Experience testing real vehicles or machines (e.g. cars, trucks, or similar systems)**

  

So, If you enjoy digging into how things really work, learning from complex systems, and collaborating with others to build reliable embedded solutions – we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now!**


If this feels like the right place for you, we’d love to hear from you.  

We’re excited to get to know you!


Note, as part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on our final candidates. This is a standard step to ensure a safe and reliable hiring process for everyone involved.


If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to **Stina Johansson**, Business Unit Manager for Embedded by Quokka.

**Email:** David.Norstedt@quokka.se

title: Software Engineer - Engineering Productivity / AI
description:
**We're looking for software engineers to grow our team Agents. You are a star with us if you have gone through the journey of product -> platform -> AI. This is us. Interested?** 




  





*AI is changing how software gets built. At Nordnet, engineers are already working with AI agents daily - and the bottlenecks are shifting. Code gets written faster, but reviews pile up. Workflows accelerate, but orchestration lags behind.* 




  





*The Agents team exists to solve this. We're a platform team responsible for scaling AI adoption and AI productivity across Nordnet by building agentic workflows and orchestration into the software development lifecycle. Right now, we're building an automated agentic code review process — our first step toward removing the review bottleneck that emerged as engineers started working more agentically.* 




  





*We're looking for engineers who want to work at the intersection of developer tooling and AI. If you're excited about designing systems that make hundreds of engineers measurably more productive, this is the role.* 




  





**What you will do** 




 In this role, you'll work across the engineering organisation to:
 


* Design and build agentic workflows that automate and accelerate parts of the SDLC
* Develop the tooling and orchestration layer for AI-assisted code review, testing, and delivery
* Identify bottlenecks in developer workflows and build AI-powered solutions to remove them
* Maintain and evolve our internal developer portal and shared tooling
* Create data-driven insights that help teams understand and improve their engineering practices
* Collaborate closely with product and platform teams to drive adoption of new tools and workflows



 This is hands-on engineering work with high organizational impact. You'll ship things that change how the entire company builds software.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 You are an engineer with a strong software development background who:
 


* Has built production systems and understands what makes them reliable
* Is curious about AI, LLMs, and agentic patterns — and wants to apply them to real problems
* Cares about developer experience and thinks in terms of reducing friction at scale
* Communicates clearly and enjoys working across teams to find pragmatic solutions
* Is comfortable navigating ambiguity — this is a fast-moving space and we're charting new territory.



 We don't expect you to tick every box. If your experience is adjacent and you're excited about building AI-powered developer tooling, we encourage you to apply.
 



  





**We value engineers who** 



* Are pragmatic and collaborative
* Are comfortable giving and receiving feedback
* Care about simplicity and measurable outcomes over complexity
* Enjoy working closely with their internal customers
* Take a scientific approach — experiment, measure, iterate



  





**Experience that will help you succeed** 



* TypeScript, Java, or Golang
* Cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
* CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
* Working with LLMs, AI APIs, or building agentic systems
* Data analysis and visualisation (BigQuery, VertexAI, or similar)
* Containerisation and orchestration (Kubernetes)



  





**We offer** 



* A collaborative environment where learning is continuous
* Meaningful technical challenges to tackle together with experienced colleagues
* A front-row seat to how AI is reshaping software engineering — and the chance to drive it
* Opportunities to grow as an engineer and/or leader
* Competitive salary and compensation



  





**Who we are** 




 Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. We became part of redefining the industry when we gave the customers power over their own savings. You will become part of a journey that has only yet started towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. To be leading in IT is pivotal for that journey and you will work with colleagues who have a great passion for that goal.
 



 We are 1000+ employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki and Copenhagen. We cooperate, exchange ideas and use our core competencies in order to continuously improve the way we meet our customers. Open communication, creativity and engagement are important parts of our everyday life at the office.
 



  





 Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is being recognized. A culture embracing our core values – passion, simplicity and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.
 



  





 Visit us on www.nordnetab.com, www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
 



  





**Application** 




 Please apply today – we interview on a continuous basis. Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.
 



 If you have questions, please contact Senior Talent Acquisition Partner Sophie Esphagen at sophie.esphagen@nordnet.se .
 



  





 We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing as part of our recruitment process.
 



  





 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Shape the Future of AI & Data with Us**
 At Datatonic, we are Google Cloud's
 **premier partner in AI,** 
 driving transformation for world-class businesses. We push the boundaries of technology with expertise in
 **machine learning, data engineering,** 
 and
 **analytics** 
 on Google Cloud Platform. By partnering with us, clients future-proof their operations, unlock actionable insights, and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving world.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 As a Data Engineer, your mission is to design and develop scalable, high-performance data pipelines that enable seamless data processing, visualisation, and integration into machine learning models.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in shaping the data engineering foundation of our next-generation AI-driven products, ensuring that data flows efficiently and is readily accessible for advanced analytics.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build Scalable Data Pipelines: Design, develop, and optimize robust data pipelines, making data easily accessible for visualization and machine learning applications.
* Leverage Cutting-Edge Technologies: Work with cloud-based platforms and big data processing tools to create scalable and efficient solutions.
* Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and analysts in an agile environment to deliver impactful data-driven solutions.
* Partner with Industry Leaders: Integrate best-in-class data solutions by working with Google Cloud Platform, dbt, and Looker.
* Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Architect, maintain, and troubleshoot cloud-based infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
* Lead and Mentor Team Members: Provide guidance and mentorship to engineers, supporting their professional development and ensuring best practices in data engineering.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Strong Programming Skills: Expertise in Python and/or Java, with proficiency in SQL.
* Experience in Data Engineering: 5+ years of experience in designing and building scalable data solutions.
* Passion for Data and Analytics: A deep interest in optimizing data workflows and making data-driven decisions.
* Expertise in ETL and Big Data: Hands-on experience with ETL tools, Hadoop-based technologies (e.g., Spark), and data processing frameworks like Beam or Flink.
* High-Quality Code Standards: Ability to write tested, resilient, and well-documented code.
* Cloud Computing Experience: Experience in building and maintaining cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS is a plus).
* Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to take ownership and drive projects from concept to completion.
* Strong Communication & Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal skills, with a team-oriented and proactive approach.
* Leadership & Mentorship Skills: Experience in line management and mentoring engineers, helping to grow the team’s technical capabilities.


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Start-Up/Scale-Up Experience: Previous experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment
* Command Line & Scripting: Love for the command line and experience with Linux scripting.
* API Development Experience: Experience building scalable REST APIs using Python or similar technologies.
* Machine Learning Knowledge: Knowledge or experience in machine learning, data mining, statistics, and visualization.
* Client-Facing Role: Prior experience in a client-facing position
* Open Source Contributions: Experience contributing to open-source projects.


**What’s in It for You?**
 We believe in empowering our team to thrive, with benefits including:
   

  

* Holiday: 30 days plus bank holidays (obviously!)
* Health Perks: 4500 kr per year Healthcare Allowance (paid monthly, after probation)
* Fitness & Wellbeing: Up to 5000 kr per year Wellness Allowance (payable on receipt of invoice)
* Hybrid Model: 1200 kr WFH Equipment Allowance (after probation)
* Learning & Growth: Access to platforms like Udemy to fuel your curiosity.
* Pension: Private Salary Sacrifice Pension available


**Why Datatonic?**
 Join us to work alongside
 **AI enthusiasts** 
 and
 **data experts** 
 who are shaping tomorrow. At Datatonic, innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s embedded in everything we do. If you’re ready to inspire change and deliver value at the forefront of data and AI, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Are you ready to make an impact?
   

  

**Apply now and take your career to the next level.**

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.
   

  

 Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.
   

  

 We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.
   

  

 Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.
   

  

 As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers
   

  

 Some of the things you'll be up to:
   

  

* Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
* Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
* Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
* Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
* Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
* Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


 So, who are you?
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.
   

  

 You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.
   

  

 At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.
   

  

 Besides the above, we believe you've got:
   

  

* Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
* Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
* Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
* Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


 Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:
   

  

* An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
* Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
* An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.
   

  

 With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.
   

  

 Ready to find out more?
   

  

 Lovely! 🎉
   

  

*Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!*
**Making it personal with AI**
 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.
   

  

 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 As the Agentic CX Suite for Retail we help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.

title: Chief Technical Officer BlueRedGold
description:
**Location:** 
 Factory site in Enköping, Sweden
 
  




**Type:** 
 Full-time, On-site
 
  




**About BlueRedGold:** 

 BlueRedGold is a Swedish agritech startup revolutionizing indoor saffron cultivation using cutting-edge technologies such as robotics and AI. We have developed superior quality, pesticide-free saffron and are now ready to scale and become the world’s leading producer. Saffron’s health benefits are rapidly gaining recognition in food, pharma, and nutraceuticals, and our proprietary methods also drastically reduce CO2 emissions. At BlueRedGold, we are committed to driving sustainability, efficiency, and innovation in agriculture and beyond.
   


**Role Summary:** 

 This is a rare chance to play a pivotal role in a rapidly growing, innovative startup with the potential to redefine an industry. We are seeking an experienced Chief Technical Officer with strong expertise in production, mechanical and electrical engineering, automation, and robotics, preferably from the food or medical industry. The ideal candidate will work closely with the Plant Manager and production team to lead the transition to a fully automated facility and production, managing the development and implementation of advanced automation systems in our new factory. As a member of the executive management team, the CTO shares responsibility for the company as a whole - not only for the technical domain - and a significant part of the role is strategic management: setting direction, owning the technology budget and investment decisions, and translating company strategy into an executable technical roadmap. Equally important is the ability to build, lead and develop a high-performing tech team.
   


**Key Responsibilities:** 

 ●     Lead the future: Spearhead the setup, scaling, and optimization of factory operations, ensuring our rapid growth meets strategic goals and budget requirements.
 



 ●     Automate innovation: Oversee the integration of robotics, PLCs, and automated systems, driving seamless operational flow in a cutting-edge production environment.
 



 ●     Build from the ground up: Manage the conception and implementation of advanced automation initiatives, from pilot to full scale, in a space where your ideas will shape the future of agriculture.
 



 ●     Raise the bar: Ensure the highest standards of production efficiency, safety, equipment utilization rate and OEE, and quality control, positioning BlueRedGold at the forefront of industry best practices.
 



 ●     Collaborate for success: Work with cross-functional teams (engineering, R&D, production) and lead external projects with customers and partners to drive innovation, foster development, and maximize productivity across the board.
 



 ●     Strategic leadership: Partner closely with the founder to shape the company's strategy and engage with key stakeholders, including investors, in this game-changing journey.
 



 ●     Create long-term success: Develop and execute strategies for financial sustainability, including profitability and cost management.
 



 ●     Build a high-performing team: Recruit, develop and retain top technical talent, set clear goals and ways of working, and create a culture of accountability, speed and continuous improvement.
 



 ●     Lead from the management team: As a member of the executive management team, contribute to company-wide decisions, priorities and trade-offs, taking ownership of the business as a whole rather than of one function alone.
 



 ●     Own the numbers: Drive strategic management work including budgeting, forecasting, investment cases and CAPEX/OPEX follow-up for the technical organisation, and connect technical choices to their business and financial consequences.
 



  





 Qualifications:
 

 ●     10+ years of experience in production automation, mechanical/electrical engineering, or a related field.
 



 ●     Proven ability to lead large-scale production and automation projects in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
 



 ●     Experience in the food production or medical industry is highly desirable.
 



 ●     Advanced degree in Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or related disciplines (MSc, PhD preferred but not required).
 



 ●     Proficient in CAD/CAM and PLC programming, with a deep understanding of the interaction between hardware, software, and human interfaces.
 



 ●     Experience with machine vision in automated production — camera and lighting setup, image-based classification or detection, and integration of vision systems with robotics — is a strong plus but not a requirement
 



 ●     A track record of building and leading teams to deliver production efficiency and innovation.
 



 ●     Proven ability to collaborate with external partners and customers, leading joint projects that drive real success.
 



 ●     Strong business acumen, with experience in managing budgets, profitability, and long-term financial goals.
 



 ●     Passion for start-ups: Thrives on the excitement of scaling a business to new heights and embraces the agility and challenges of a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
 



 ●     Strong management and leadership skills: proven experience of building and leading high-performing technical teams, including recruitment, structure, goal setting and performance management.
 



 ●     Experience from an executive management team or equivalent senior leadership role, with the ability to see the whole business - commercial, operational and financial - and not only your own area of expertise.
 



  





 Technical Skills:
 

 ●     Hands-on ability to design, prototype, and iterate on collaborative robotic and non-robotic automation: process definition, positioning, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, end effectors, force control
 



 ●     Expertise in embedded systems, database management, and AI/ML applications within production environments.
 



 ●     Familiarity with SCADA systems, strong control architecture instincts, and experience in process optimization and quality control.
 



 ●     Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
 



 ●     Knowledge and pragmatism in both components and solution build-versus-buy
 



  





 Personality Traits:
 

 ●     Visionary leader: Able to see long-term growth opportunities and inspire a team to achieve groundbreaking results.
 



 ●     Hands-on and adaptable: Thrives in both high-level strategy and day-to-day problem-solving in a start-up environment.
 



 ●     Entrepreneurial spirit: Passionate about building and scaling businesses.
 



 ●     Solution-oriented: Ability to navigate complex challenges with a proactive, hands-on approach.
 



 ●     Committed to sustainability: Passionate about ethical practices and making a positive impact.
 



 ●     Team builder: Genuinely motivated by developing people, creating clarity and getting the best out of a diverse technical team.
 



  





 Offer:
 

 ●     Competitive compensation package including stock options available.
 



 ●     Unique opportunity to make a lasting impact and be part of an innovative company disrupting an entire industry.
 



  





 How to Apply:
 

 Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your qualifications and why you are a good fit for this role at Alva labs.
